title: A 3D-$\Delta$PDF-like measure for hidden anisotropy in disordered materials
summary: We introduce a simple correlation function for quantifying hidden local anisotropy in disordered materials. Developed in analogy with the three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-$\Delta$PDF), our approach identifies structural correlations that are lost through averaging over bulk symmetry. The same approach might be applied to models of disordered crystals, amorphous materials, and liquids alike.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单的相关函数，用于定量表征无序材料中隐藏的局域各向异性结构关联。
AI.motivation: 传统体相平均会掩盖无序材料中偏离整体对称性的局域结构关联，因此需要一种能够识别这些被平均掉的信息的方法。
AI.method: 借鉴三维差分对分布函数（3D-ΔPDF）的思想，构造一种简单的相关函数，用于提取和量化局域各向异性关联。
AI.result: 该方法能够识别因体相对称性平均而丢失的结构关联，并可望推广至无序晶体、非晶材料及液体等体系。
AI.conclusion: 该相关函数为研究无序材料中隐藏的局域各向异性提供了一种简洁且具有普适潜力的分析工具。

title: p-Adic statistical field theory of fluctuation effects in hierarchical neural networks
summary: The Buice-Cowan field theory [PRE 75, 051919 (2007)] describes fluctuations and correlations of neural activity through a path integral whose mean-field limit is the Wilson-Cowan equation and whose critical behavior belongs to the directed percolation class. In its continuum limit the neurons are the points of a Euclidean space and activity spreads by ordinary diffusion, which encodes neither the hierarchical organization of cortical networks nor their small-world property. We formulate a version of the theory in which the neurons are organized in an infinite, self-similar, tree-like structure, described by the p-adic numbers. The path integral carries over unchanged, and finite networks are exact restrictions of the continuum theory. The main change is in the linear response: in the Euclidean theory every short-range kernel reduces to the Laplacian, while in the p-adic theory each connectivity kernel gives its own nonlocal p-adic diffusion operator. For couplings that decay by a fixed factor per level of the hierarchy this is the Taibleson-Vladimirov operator, and the critical theory is an ultrametric Reggeon field theory whose upper critical dimension is twice the decay exponent of the coupling. Hence the decay of the coupling up the hierarchy, and not the dimension of space, decides whether mean-field exponents apply. We obtain a Ginzburg-type criterion, loop-corrected hierarchical Wilson-Cowan equations, log-periodic corrections to scaling and power-law correlations. Exact simulations on a tree support the predictions: the avalanche-size exponent takes the mean-field value 3/2 when the coupling decays slowly and decreases toward the directed-percolation value when it decays fast. The hierarchical network is also small-world when the decay exponent is smaller than the dimension, a property that the Euclidean theory obtains only by assuming long-range coupling.

AI.tldr: 将Buice-Cowan神经场论从欧氏空间推广到由p-adic数描述的无限自相似树状网络，得到超度量Reggeon场论；临界行为由层级耦合衰减指数而非空间维数决定，并由树上的精确模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 原连续理论用普通扩散描述神经元，无法体现皮层网络的层级组织和small-world特性。
AI.method: 在p-adic/树状层级上重新表述路径积分；有限网络为连续理论的精确限制；线性响应由非局域p-adic扩散算子给出，固定层级衰减对应Taibleson-Vladimirov算子，临界理论为超度量Reggeon场论。
AI.result: 上临界维数为耦合衰减指数的两倍；得到Ginzburg型判据、圈修正的层级Wilson-Cowan方程、对数周期标度修正和幂律关联。树上精确模拟显示：耦合慢衰减时雪崩尺寸指数为平均场值3/2，快衰减时趋近有向渗流值；衰减指数小于维数时网络呈small-world。
AI.conclusion: 决定是否适用平均场指数的是耦合沿层级的衰减而非空间维数；层级网络可自然产生small-world与幂律临界现象，扩展了Buice-Cowan理论对皮层网络的应用范围。

title: Hierarchical connectivity sets the upper critical dimension of neural avalanches
summary: Neural avalanches with size exponent $3/2$ are usually explained by mean-field critical branching, which for short-range coupling requires dimension $N\ge4$. We show that hierarchical connectivity removes this constraint. In a $p$-adic version of the Buice--Cowan field theory, a coupling that decays by $p^{-(N+\sigma)}$ per hierarchical level selects the Taibleson--Vladimirov operator, and the critical theory is ultrametric directed percolation with upper critical dimension $N_c=2\sigma$. Exact simulations on a tree give $\tau_S=3/2$ for $\sigma\le N/2$, decreasing continuously for $\sigma>N/2$.

AI.tldr: 层级连接可在低于四维时产生尺寸指数为3/2的神经雪崩，临界行为由超度量有向渗流描述。
AI.motivation: 神经雪崩中尺寸指数3/2通常归因于平均场临界分支，但短程耦合下平均场需维度N≥4，本文旨在说明层级连接如何解除该维度限制。
AI.method: 构建p-adic版本的Buice–Cowan场论，令耦合按每一层级以p^{-(N+σ)}衰减，从而选出Taibleson–Vladimirov算子；并将临界理论对应为超度量有向渗流，辅以树上的精确模拟。
AI.result: 临界理论的上临界维度为N_c=2σ；树上精确模拟得到当σ≤N/2时尺寸指数τ_S=3/2，而当σ>N/2时τ_S连续下降。
AI.conclusion: 层级连接去除了短程平均场分支对N≥4的要求，使3/2雪崩指数可在更低维度出现，并由超度量有向渗流及N_c=2σ刻画。

title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
summary: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“原子即智能体”（AaaA）原则，将集体预测编码（CPC）用于物理系统，说明宏观序参量可仅由微观自旋构型数据中自动涌现，而无需依赖微观哈密顿量/拉格朗日结构。
AI.motivation: 论文关注的核心问题是：宏观序参量为何以及如何从微观系统中涌现。作者类比语言从人类交流中涌现，认为物理宏观序参量可从原子间相互预测与推断的“交流”中涌现。
AI.method: 作者将每个原子视为通过推断预测彼此行为的智能体，并把语言/符号涌现理论中的CPC应用于物理。具体考察三类经典自旋系统：二维铁磁与反铁磁Ising模型、具有竞争条纹序的二维自旋模型，以及全连接Sherrington-Kirkpatrick自旋玻璃模型。方法仅使用观测到的自旋构型，通过CPC的通信信息学学习宏观坐标。
AI.result: 在所有例子中，包括复本重叠在内的适当宏观序参量均自动涌现；作者将学到的宏观坐标称为“集体预测序”。对于铁磁和反铁磁Ising模型，集体预测序的平衡分布产生一个涌现势，其对称性和热演化特征符合Landau势。该涌现过程不参考微观哈密顿量/拉格朗日量的任何结构。
AI.conclusion: 因此，AaaA原则提供了一种完全数据驱动的宏观序涌现方法，即机器学习物理；它表明宏观序参量可仅从微观观测数据中通过集体预测通信机制自动学习得到。

title: Replica Analysis of Overfitting in Vector Generalized Linear Models
summary: We show how the successful recent statistical physics based theory of overfitting in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) can be generalized to a much larger family of regression models: the so-called Vector Generalized Linear Models (VGLMs), in which not a single linear combination of covariates drives the outcome, but where one has an arbitrary finite number of such linear combinations. The latter more general and complex models can describe more sophisticated statistical patterns in data, but are even more prone to overfitting than GLMs due to their significantly larger number of parameters; this often limits their use. We show that the generalization of the overfitting theory from GLMs to VGLMs causes many mathematical challenges that were absent from the earlier work, mostly related to the increased dimensional complexity of all order parameters in the theory, but that the new problem is once more solvable using the replica method. This opens up the field to many novel and welcome applications, especially in post-genome medical inference and data analysis, where overfitting is and remains a major barrier to progress. After developing the general VGLM overfitting theory, within the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz, we illustrate its merits and its correctness via application to several relevant VGLM regression models.

AI.tldr: 该文将广义线性模型（GLM）的统计物理过拟合理论推广到向量广义线性模型（VGLM），并在副本对称（RS）拟设下建立可解框架。
AI.motivation: VGLM 允许多个线性组合共同驱动结果，能刻画更复杂的数据模式，但参数更多、更易过拟合，限制其应用；尤其在后基因组医学推断与数据分析中，过拟合是主要障碍。
AI.method: 将 GLM 过拟合理论推广到 VGLM；处理因所有序参量维度复杂性增加带来的数学挑战；采用副本方法（replica method）求解，并在副本对称（RS）拟设下推导一般理论，随后应用于若干相关 VGLM 回归模型以验证。
AI.result: 表明从 GLM 到 VGLM 的推广虽引入新的高维数学困难，但问题仍可通过副本方法求解；通过多个 VGLM 回归模型的应用展示了理论的有效性与正确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把过拟合的统计物理分析扩展到更一般的 VGLM 家族，为复杂回归模型的过拟合研究及后基因组医学等应用提供了新的理论工具。

title: Perfect sampling of Ising spin glasses with bounding chains
summary: We study perfect sampling algorithms for Ising spin glasses based on coupling from the past and bounding chains, on several graph families and coupling distributions. For the single-site bounding chain, we establish coalescence in $O(n\log n)$ updates under Dobrushin conditions. On sparse random graphs, our numerical results suggest that efficient sampling extends throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, with a slowdown beyond this threshold. On Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi random graphs $\mathcal{G}(n,d/n)$ with standard Gaussian couplings, we introduce a block bounding chain and prove its coalescence in $O(n\log n)$ block updates in the tree-uniqueness regime for sufficiently large $d$, each block update requiring $O(n)$ operations, adapting a proof in~\cite{Efthymiou_Zampetakis_2024} for the rapid mixing of block Glauber dynamics. On periodic lattices, our experiments instead suggest that the single-site bounding chain is limited by the looseness of its bounding envelope, whereas on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, slow coalescence is accompanied by damage spreading at every inverse temperature tested. These observations motivate alternative bounding representations and couplings as strategies to improve perfect sampling on spin glasses.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Ising自旋玻璃的完美采样，基于coupling from the past与bounding chains，在多种图族和耦合分布上分析单点与块bounding chain的合并性质，并给出理论保证与数值观察。
AI.motivation: 完美采样在自旋玻璃上通常受限于bounding chain合并慢或bounding envelope过松；作者希望在稀疏随机图、周期格点和Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型等场景中厘清其可行范围与瓶颈，并寻找改进方向。
AI.method: 对单点bounding chain，在Dobrushin条件下证明O(n log n)次更新的合并；在稀疏随机图上数值研究树唯一性区域内的效率；在G(n,d/n) Erdős-Rényi随机图上采用标准Gaussian耦合，引入块bounding chain，并借用Efthymiou-Zampetakis 2024关于块Glauber动力学快速混合的证明，证明足够大d时树唯一性区域内O(n log n)次块更新合并且每次块更新O(n)；在周期格点与SK模型上进行实验分析。
AI.result: 单点bounding chain在Dobrushin条件下具有O(n log n)更新合并保证；稀疏随机图数值结果显示高效采样可延伸至树唯一性区域，超过阈值后变慢；ER随机图上块bounding chain在足够大d的树唯一性区域获得O(n log n)块更新合并保证；周期格点实验表明单点bounding chain受bounding envelope过松限制；SK模型上观察到慢合并伴随各测试逆温度下的damage spreading。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果刻画了bounding chain完美采样在自旋玻璃上的适用范围与瓶颈，并表明需要发展替代的bounding表示与耦合策略以改进自旋玻璃上的完美采样。

title: Chaos picture of spin glasses
summary: The chaos picture is a novel, coherent, and intuitive theoretical framework for spin glasses, reconciling the 40-year-old droplet vs. replica symmetry breaking debate. First, we argue the formation of a hierarchical energy landscape by pinning and dynamic filtering of random droplets. As the temperature decreases, the chaos picture describes a progressive freezing of scale-dependent droplets in real space, which mirrors a hierarchical free energy landscape fracturing process in phase space. This bifurcation process is accompanied by temperature chaos, leading to dynamic pure state coexistence without violating the droplet scaling. Crucially, the interface geometry is not critical to these mechanisms, naturally incorporating the interface crossover from planar, fractal, to space-filling as the dimensionality increases, in line with the mean-field limit. Finally, the chaos picture provides profound insights into spin-glass dynamics such as aging, rejuvenation, and memory effect, while offering a streamlined reinterpretation of the complex metastate framework.

AI.tldr: 提出“混沌图像”（chaos picture）作为自旋玻璃的统一理论框架，调和液滴图像与复制对称破缺（RSB）之间长达40年的争论，并统一解释层级能景、温度混沌、界面交叉及老化等动力学现象。
AI.motivation: 自旋玻璃领域长期存在液滴图像与RSB图像的范式冲突；作者希望用一个连贯、直观的框架同时容纳液滴标度、层级自由能景观、温度混沌、界面几何交叉和复杂亚稳态（metastate）描述。
AI.method: 通过理论论证：随机液滴经钉扎与动态过滤形成层级能量景观；降温时尺度依赖液滴在实空间渐进冻结，并对应相空间自由能景观的层级碎裂；该分岔过程伴随温度混沌；界面几何并非关键，可自然包含随维度增加从平面、分形到空间填充的界面交叉。
AI.result: 该框架导致不违反液滴标度的动态纯态共存；界面交叉与平均场极限一致；并对老化、 rejuvenation、记忆效应等自旋玻璃动力学给出深刻解释，同时简化复杂metastate框架的重述。
AI.conclusion: 混沌图像为自旋玻璃提供一个连贯且直观的统一理论：既保留液滴标度核心，又纳入RSB式层级景观与温度混沌，从而调和两大传统图像并连接界面几何、动力学与metastate描述。

title: Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
summary: Gauge-Higgs theory in flat spacetime provides a prime theoretical model of multiple phases of matter with distinct entanglement structures. More recently, there has been interest in hyperbolic space and the influence its extensive boundaries have on these structures. Entanglement transitions between non-equilibrium phases, such as topological phases, can be realized by the competition of non-commutating measurements. Here we study the entanglement phases of gauge-Higgs models on hyperbolic lattices described by measurement-only dynamics. We chart 2D phase diagrams by employing topological entanglement entropy and introducing a generalized measurement-induced entanglement tailored for hyperbolic Higgs phases. Utilizing duality, we find a phase absent in Euclidean space, wherein the bulk lattice hosts separated clusters of symmetry-protected topological order. Transitions between this "archipelago" phase and neighboring topological and trivial phases feature a critical exponent $\delta$ belonging to a mean-field universality class. Our essential tool is a 3D resource state inspired by measurement-based quantum computation that simulates the spacetime evolution of the 2D quantum state with a third direction of entanglement. This allows us to analyze spacetime "sponges" of entanglement, which map to classical percolation theory and allow us to infer values of critical points on our phase diagrams' boundaries.

AI.tldr: 该文研究双曲格子上规范-Higgs模型在仅测量动力学下的纠缠相，发现欧氏空间中没有的“群岛”相，并利用三维资源态与经典渗流映射确定相图及临界点。
AI.motivation: 平直时空中的规范-Higgs理论可描述具有不同纠缠结构的多相物质；双曲空间的广泛边界及其对纠缠结构的影响近期受到关注，而拓扑等非平衡相之间的纠缠转变可由非对易测量竞争实现。
AI.method: 在双曲格子上研究仅测量动力学驱动的规范-Higgs模型纠缠相；用拓扑纠缠熵和针对双曲Higgs相引入的广义测量诱导纠缠绘制二维相图；利用对偶性分析相结构；核心工具是受测量基量子计算启发的三维资源态，以第三维纠缠模拟二维量子态的时空演化，并将时空纠缠“海绵”映射到经典渗流理论以推断相图边界上的临界点。
AI.result: 发现一个欧氏空间中不存在的“群岛”相，其体格点包含分离的对称保护拓扑序团簇；该相与相邻拓扑相和平庸相之间的转变具有属于平均场普适类的临界指数δ。
AI.conclusion: 双曲仅测量规范-Higgs模型展现出新的群岛型对称保护拓扑纠缠相，其相变可由平均场临界指数刻画；三维资源态与经典渗流映射为分析时空纠缠结构和确定相图边界临界点提供了有效框架。

title: Tunable turning point of the frequency--temperature response in suspended bilayer SiN_x/Al nanofilms
summary: Non-invasive thermometry is highly desirable in cryogenic experiments to avoid the self-heating inherent in conventional sensors. In previous work, temperature was probed via the vibrational eigenfrequency of a suspended single-layer SiNx nanofilm. However, the turning point of the frequency-temperature curve limited the usable measurement range. Moreover, the slow thermal response confined measurements to a stepwise protocol with only discrete temperature points. Here, we show that these limitations can be overcome with a suspended bilayer SiNx/Al nanofilm, whose temperature-dependent vibrational eigenfrequency provides a monotonic, continuous, and repeatable temperature readout. The frequency-temperature dependence is governed by the mismatch between the effective coefficients of thermal expansion (CTE) of the bilayer and the substrate, which makes the turning point tunable through the thickness ratio of the two layers. Over the 90 K to 300 K range, we characterize three bilayer nanofilms with different Al layer thicknesses and show how the turning point shifts with the thickness of the Al layer. For the sample with 72 nm Al, the turning point is pushed beyond 300 K, yielding a monotonic negative temperature coefficient over the entire 90 K to 300 K range. Combining a thin Al layer on the SiNx film with improved thermal anchoring of the chip shortens the thermal response to below 1 s, enabling continuous frequency tracking at a ramp rate of 3 K/min. We also demonstrate that the nanofilm with a 72 nm Al layer achieves a repeatability better than 150 mK above 175 K, and the frequency resolution of 1 Hz corresponds to a temperature resolution of ~5 mK.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用悬浮SiNx/Al双层纳米膜的温度相关振动本征频率实现非侵入式测温，通过调节Al层厚度移动频率-温度曲线拐点，实现90–300 K范围内单调、连续、可重复且快速响应的温度读出。
AI.motivation: 低温实验中传统传感器存在自加热问题，非侵入测温很有吸引力；此前单层SiNx纳米膜的频率-温度曲线拐点限制测量范围，且热响应慢，只能采用离散温度点的阶梯式测量。
AI.method: 制备悬浮SiNx/Al双层纳米膜，利用其振动本征频率随温度变化进行测温；频率-温度依赖由双层膜与衬底的有效热膨胀系数失配决定，并通过SiNx/Al厚度比调节拐点。表征三种不同Al层厚度样品在90–300 K范围内的行为，并改善芯片热锚定以实现连续频率跟踪。
AI.result: 72 nm Al样品将拐点推至300 K以上，在90–300 K全范围呈单调负温度系数；热响应缩短至1 s以下，可在3 K/min升温速率下连续跟踪。该样品在175 K以上重复性优于150 mK，1 Hz频率分辨率对应约5 mK温度分辨率。
AI.conclusion: SiNx/Al双层纳米膜克服了单层SiNx的测量范围与响应速度限制，可实现宽温区、连续、可重复、快速的非侵入式温度探测，且拐点可通过层厚比调控。

title: Spin Relaxation and Electrical Control of Spin Transport in Few-Layer $T_{\rm d}$-MoTe$_2$
summary: We report electrical tuning of spin relaxation in atomically thin $T_{\rm d}$-MoTe$_2$, a representative low-symmetry transition metal dichalcogenide. Weak antilocalization measurements reveal strong spin--orbit interaction with spin--orbit lengths of tens of nanometers, consistent with recent theoretical predictions. Despite the semimetallic nature of $T_{\rm d}$-MoTe$_2$, in the ultrathin limit the spin--orbit scattering time can be tuned electrostatically by up to threefold. We further investigate vertical electric field effects on the spin--orbit length and time, and demonstrate the modulation of the Rashba parameters. Relation between spin--orbit scattering time and the diffusion coefficient indicates that spin relaxation is governed by the D'yakonov--Perel' mechanism in both monolayer and bilayer $T_{\rm d}$-MoTe$_2$. These results establish few-layer $T_{\rm d}$-MoTe$_2$ as a platform for electrically tunable spin transport, thereby providing insight into spin relaxation in low-symmetry transition metal dichalcogenides.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了少层低对称性Td-MoTe2中自旋弛豫的电学调控，利用弱反局域化测量揭示强自旋-轨道耦合，并证明单层和双层中的自旋弛豫由D'yakonov-Perel'机制主导。
AI.motivation: 低对称性过渡金属硫族化物中的自旋输运与自旋弛豫机制尚需深入理解，尤其需要探索能否通过电场调控自旋-轨道相互作用及相关自旋弛豫参数。

title: Laser-Induced 90-Degree Magnetization Switching for Single-Element 2D Sensing
summary: Magnetoresistive sensors with multiaxial sensitivity are interesting for field mapping applications where local measurement of multiple magnetic field components is needed. Existing device designs are often discretized with separate sensing elements for each vector component, or they require complex detection schemes to distinguish the different components. In this work, we showcase a single-element two-dimensional vector sensor with on-demand reprogrammable sensing axis using light and optically switchable materials. Our device is an anisotropic magnetoresistive sensor with $90^\circ$ togglable sensitivity upon excitation with ultrashort laser pulses. The sensor consists of an optically switchable Co/Gd thin-film bilayer, patterned into a cross shape that stabilizes two orthogonal in-plane magnetization directions. By selectively addressing one diagonal of the cross, a single laser pulses toggle switches the magnetization direction in the center of the cross by $90^\circ$. Moreover, the field sensitivity of the device is toggled between the $x$- and $y$-axes, which we detected electrically with the planar Hall effect. Our results form a milestone towards optically reprogrammable integrated magnetic vector sensors.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种基于Co/Gd光学可开关薄膜的单元件二维矢量磁阻传感器，可通过超短激光脉冲在x轴与y轴灵敏度之间按需切换。
AI.motivation: 多轴磁阻传感器在局部磁场多分量测量与场映射中很有价值，但现有方案通常需要分立传感元件或复杂探测方案来区分不同矢量分量。
AI.method: 器件为图案化成十字形的Co/Gd双层各向异性磁阻传感器，十字结构稳定两个正交面内磁化方向；通过选择性照射十字的一条对角线，用单次激光脉冲使中心磁化方向旋转90°，并利用平面霍尔效应电学检测灵敏度在x轴和y轴之间的切换。
AI.result: 实现了单元件二维矢量传感，并可通过超短激光脉冲将90°可切换的磁阻灵敏度在x轴与y轴之间进行按需重编程。
AI.conclusion: 该结果朝着光学可重编程集成磁矢量传感器迈出了重要一步。

title: Ferron-driven motion of non-collinear ferroelectric domain walls
summary: We study the propagation of ferrons, the quanta of electric polarization waves, through a ferroelectric texture. We predict by analytic and numerical calculations that a $90^\circ$ domain wall (DW) operates as a beam splitter of longitudinal ferron and transverse optical phonon modes. An associated momentum-flux imbalance leads to forces that drive DW motion. In the weak-anisotropy limit, the DW becomes a rotating texture with nearly fixed-modulus, whose low-energy dynamics is described by a sine-Gordon equation. A ferron source then attracts the DW through a damping-induced force. Both driving forces scale linearly with incident wave intensity. Our results uncover qualitatively different routes to driven ferroelectric DW motion enabled by the vector nature of the polarization and offer functionalities for THz ferroelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 通过解析与数值计算研究铁电畴壁对铁子（电极化波量子）的传播：90°畴壁可作为纵向铁子与横向光学声子模的分束器，动量通量不平衡驱动畴壁运动；弱各向异性下畴壁呈近固定模量旋转织构，低能动力学由sine-Gordon方程描述，铁子源可通过阻尼诱导力吸引畴壁，且两种驱动力均与入射波强度线性相关。
AI.motivation: 揭示由极化矢量性质决定的铁电畴壁驱动机制，并探索其在太赫兹铁电器件中的功能潜力。
AI.method: 采用解析计算与数值模拟，分析铁子在90°铁电畴壁处的传播、动量通量及畴壁受力；在弱各向异性极限下用sine-Gordon方程描述近固定模量旋转织构的低能动力学，并考察铁子源引起的阻尼诱导力。
AI.result: 90°畴壁对纵向铁子和横向光学声子模具有分束效应；相关动量通量不平衡产生驱动畴壁运动的力；弱各向异性时畴壁变为近固定模量旋转织构；铁子源通过阻尼诱导力吸引畴壁；两种驱动力均随入射波强度线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了由极化矢量性质赋能的、不同于传统机制的铁电畴壁驱动路径，并为太赫兹铁电器件提供了功能设计思路。

title: Robustness of Anyonic Time-Domain Interference Against Dephasing
summary: Recent anyon-collider experiments have identified time-domain braiding (TDB) as a new route to probing anyonic statistics. However, how such time-domain interference responds to environmental noise remains an open question. Here we show that TDB interference is intrinsically more robust than its spatial counterpart. In conventional spatial interference, environmental noise induces phase fluctuations that accumulate throughout all paths, leading to exponential suppression of the interference as the dephasing rate increases. In TDB, by contrast, the interfering temporal paths experience largely overlapping environmental fluctuations, whose contributions cancel out in the relative phase, so that only a small nonoverlapping temporal window contributes to dephasing. As a result, TDB interference decays only algebraically with the dephasing rate, providing a new experimental hallmark for its identification. We propose a Fabry-Perot fractional quantum Hall setup in which both types of interference coexist and experience the same environmental noise, enabling a direct comparison of their dephasing behaviors. Our results establish robustness against dephasing as a fundamental advantage of TDB and suggest new opportunities for exploiting anyonic interference in noisy mesoscopic systems.

AI.tldr: 该文指出时间域编织（TDB）干涉比空间干涉更能抵抗环境退相干，并通过分数量子霍尔Fabry-Perot装置提出可直接比较二者退相干行为的方案。
AI.motivation: 近期任意子对撞实验将时间域编织识别为探测任意子统计的新途径，但其时间域干涉如何响应环境噪声仍不清楚。
AI.method: 作者理论分析TDB与常规空间干涉在环境相位涨落下的退相干行为，并提出一个分数量子霍尔Fabry-Perot装置，使两类干涉共存并经历相同环境噪声以进行直接比较。
AI.result: 空间干涉中噪声相位涨落沿所有路径累积，导致干涉随退相干率指数抑制；TDB中相互干涉的时间路径经历高度重叠的环境涨落，其贡献在相对相位中抵消，仅小段非重叠时间窗口贡献退相干，因此TDB干涉仅随退相干率代数衰减。
AI.conclusion: 抗退相干性是TDB的基本优势，代数衰减可作为其新实验特征，并为在噪声介观系统中利用任意子干涉提供新机会。

title: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
summary: Photon-magnon synchronized modes (PMSMs) provide a route for magnetic-field sensing by exploiting their enhanced field responsivity due to cusp points (CPs). However, the previous PMSM magnetometer relies on bulky discrete components and lacks in situ control of photon-magnon interactions, limiting its integration and adaptability. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized PMSM magnetometer integrated on a printed circuit board. A variable resistor is used to tune the photon-magnon coupling strength in situ. By adjusting the variable resistor, the electromagnetic boundary condition of the magnetometer is altered; hence, the reservoir-mediated photon-magnon interaction is changed. The coupling strength shows a non-monotonic dependence on the reflection coefficient adjusted by the variable resistor and reaches its minimum at the impedance matching condition. Furthermore, we develop a non-Hermitian model with standing-wave interference to describe the PMSM dispersion and derive the critical condition for CP formation. This work realizes a compact and tunable PMSM magnetometer and provides a pathway for controlling photon-magnon interactions in integrated magnetic sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于印刷电路板集成的微型光子-磁振子同步模式磁强计，利用可变电阻原位调节光子-磁振子耦合强度，并建立非厄米驻波干涉模型解释色散与尖点形成条件。
AI.motivation: 传统光子-磁振子同步模式磁强计依赖笨重分立器件，且缺乏对光子-磁振子相互作用的原位调控，限制集成化与适应性。
AI.method: 将PMSM磁强计集成于印刷电路板，通过可变电阻改变电磁边界条件与反射系数，从而调节腔库介导的光子-磁振子相互作用；耦合强度随反射系数非单调变化并在阻抗匹配时达到最小；同时建立包含驻波干涉的非厄米模型描述PMSM色散并推导尖点形成的临界条件。
AI.result: 实现了紧凑、可调谐的PMSM磁强计；实验表明耦合强度可通过可变电阻原位调控，且其最小值出现在阻抗匹配条件；理论模型可描述PMSM色散并给出尖点临界条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了集成化、可调谐的PMSM磁强计，并为集成磁传感系统中光子-磁振子相互作用的调控提供了途径。

title: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
summary: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.

AI.tldr: 该文在七轨道 2×2 超胞蜂窝-空位晶格中研究如何由精确平带母体构造孤立陈带，揭示破坏性干涉、跃迁相位与键的元胞平移共同决定可实现的拓扑带。
AI.motivation: 平带母体并不自动给出孤立陈带；需要理解键连接、跃迁相位和元胞平移如何约束平带的拓扑化与能隙打开。
AI.method: 结合解析约化、Bloch 谱、晶格陈不变量和量子几何，分析七轨道 2×2 超胞蜂窝-空位晶格中的平带、零模与紧局域态，并考察层内环路跃迁、交错手性着色及键连接改变的影响。
AI.result: 母体具有三条精确平带、光滑周期零模和紧局域态；微弱层内环路跃迁保持两个拓扑平庸绝缘能隙。交错手性着色将相隔半倒格周期的相反能量联系起来，使孤立中心带只能具有偶数陈数，并在所有环路相位下禁止零能绝缘填充。纯虚环路跃迁可用实数规范描述，其他相位则允许中心带间形成配对能带接触（陈数 2 与 4）。在特定强环路截断下，三阶质量项打开直接能隙，且能隙随耦合增长比带宽收缩更快；改为有向蜂窝次近邻连接可得到更窄且量子几何非均匀的陈带。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了单带拓扑与占据组拓扑，并表明键连接和元胞平移决定从精确平带母体中可以涌现哪些拓扑带。

title: Magnetic Imaging with High Spatial Resolution Using a Single Niobium-Nitride-Based Three-Dimensional Nanobridge Junction
summary: The nanobridge junctions (NBJs) allow the miniaturization of the Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) and improve the spatial resolution of scanning SQUID microscopy. However, the SQUID loop diameter imposed a fundamental limit on the resolution. In this work, we proposed a single niobium-nitride-based three-dimensional nanobridge junction (NbN-3D-NBJ) alternative to the nanoSQUID for high-resolution magnetic imaging. The critical current of an NbN-3D-NBJ showed an nearly monotonic dependence on the external magnetic field, enabling nanoscale mapping of the magnetic field distribution by measuring the junction's critical current with an intrinsic noise level of 100 nT/Hz^1/2. Using a NbN-3D-NBJ probe, we successfully imaged an Abrikosov vortex in a niobium film with a minimal full width at half maxima (FWHM) of 530 nm, constrained by the distance from the junction to the probe tip edge. Furthermore, we resolved 80 nm spacings between the superconducting nanowires utilizing a second probe with an optimized junction-to-tip distance. Thus, the single 3D NbN NBJ probe has been demonstrated as an effective approach for magnetic imaging with ultra-high spatial resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于氮化铌的三维纳米桥结（NbN-3D-NBJ）单结磁成像探针，作为纳米SQUID的替代方案，实现高空间分辨磁场成像，并成功观测Abrikosov涡旋及80 nm间距的超导纳米线。
AI.motivation: 纳米桥结可小型化SQUID并提升扫描SQUID显微空间分辨率，但SQUID环路直径构成分辨率的基本限制，因此需要摆脱环路尺寸约束的高分辨率磁成像方案。
AI.method: 制备单个NbN三维纳米桥结，利用其临界电流对外磁场近乎单调的依赖关系，通过测量结的临界电流实现纳米尺度磁场分布映射，并构建扫描探针进行磁成像。
AI.result: NbN-3D-NBJ的本征噪声水平为100 nT/Hz^1/2；用其探针在铌薄膜中成像Abrikosov涡旋，最小半高全宽（FWHM）为530 nm，受结到探针尖端边缘距离限制；采用优化结-尖端距离的第二支探针，分辨出超导纳米线间80 nm的间距。
AI.conclusion: 单个三维NbN纳米桥结探针是一种有效的超高空问分辨率磁成像方法，可规避纳米SQUID环路直径限制，并展示出纳米尺度磁场分布与超导结构表征能力。

title: Spin-Orbit-Torque-Driven Recurrent Motion of Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions for Magnetic Clocking
summary: Magnetic skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets have emerged as attractive information carriers for spintronic technologies due to their compensated topology, which mitigates the skyrmion Hall effect and facilitates reliable current-driven transport. Here we present a frequency-tunable magnetic clocking concept based on the recurring translational motion of SAF skyrmions and define the material conditions needed to realize it in a Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co multilayer. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the combined effects of interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida exchange coupling, delineating the parameter space in which coupled N\'eel-type skyrmions with opposite topological charges form a stable, topologically compensated pair. Under spin-orbit torque excitation, the SAF skyrmions exhibit resilient longitudinal transport with minimal transverse deflection using periodic boundary conditions. Periodic boundary conditions serve as an idealized model for closed-loop racetrack geometries, facilitating the study of continuous transport cycles and long-range steady-state dynamics. The oscillation frequency is readily modified by the applied current density and material characteristics, offering a pathway to field-free nanoscale timing components. Moreover, the threshold-activated initiation of recurrent transport mimics tonic-spiking behavior, indicating possible use in neuromorphic signal generation. This work establishes SAF skyrmions as versatile building elements for future spintronic functional devices by integrating topological protection, controllable transport, and cyclic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于合成反铁磁体（SAF）中拓扑补偿斯格明子往复平移的磁时钟概念，并通过微磁模拟研究其在Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co多层膜中的实现条件与可调输运特性。
AI.motivation: SAF斯格明子因拓扑补偿可抑制斯格明子霍尔效应，适合作为自旋电子学信息载体；作者希望利用其稳定、可控的循环输运构建无场纳米计时与类神经形态信号源。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟研究界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）与层间RKKY交换耦合的联合作用，确定形成稳定、拓扑补偿的反对称拓扑荷Néel型斯格明子对的参数空间；在自旋轨道矩（SOT）激发下，结合周期性边界条件模拟闭合赛道中的连续输运循环。
AI.result: SAF斯格明子对在SOT驱动下表现出稳健的纵向输运和极小横向偏转；其振荡频率可由施加电流密度和材料参数调节；周期性输运具有阈值激活的起始行为，类似tonic-spiking，可用于神经形态信号生成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将拓扑保护、可控输运与循环动力学结合，确立SAF斯格明子作为未来自旋电子功能器件（如无场纳米计时和神经形态信号源）的多功能构建单元。

title: Two Exceptional-Point Regimes in the Spinterface Model of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
summary: The spinterface model of chirality-induced spin selectivity supports two algebraically distinct near-exceptional-point (EP) regimes, which cannot be mixed. A \emph{gold-level} near-EP involves the two gold spin states under an anti-Hermitian, electrode-mediated spin flip with spin-symmetric dissipative broadening (Scheme~B). A \emph{chain-level} near-EP involves the collective coalescence of the two molecular eigenstates with largest weight on the first molecular site under a Hermitian on-site Rashba spin flip with spin-dependent broadening (Scheme~A). Mixing the diagonal cancellation of one scheme with the off-diagonal structure of the other yields a strictly negative discriminant and admits no EP on any parameter path, making the gold/chain classification exhaustive. At the gold near-EP the spin-flip coupling is chirality-selective, converting achiral spin-valve transport into purely chiral transport across well-defined crossover points. At the chain near-EP the Petermann factor grows as a power law in chain length, with an exponent tunable by the Rashba coherence length and non-monotonic in the Rashba strength, reflecting a balance between coherent enhancement and progressive breakdown of the Scheme-A condition. Both near-EPs are dressed versions of the ideal two-state EP, and the ratio between observed and bare EP locations measures the delocalisation of the coalescing pair, providing a fit-free diagnostic of the mechanism. These results identify CISS junctions as a solid-state platform for non-Hermitian spectral physics.

AI.tldr: 该文在CISS界面的spinterface模型中识别出两类代数上不可混合的近例外点（near-EP）：金级（Scheme B）与链级（Scheme A），并揭示其输运与谱学特征。
AI.motivation: 将手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）结作为固态平台研究非厄米谱物理，并厘清不同近EP机制的代数结构与可观测后果。
AI.method: 构建spinterface非厄米模型：Scheme B为电极介导的反厄米自旋翻转与自旋对称耗散展宽，作用于两个金自旋态；Scheme A为厄米在位Rashba自旋翻转与自旋相关展宽，导致分子本征态集体合并。通过判别式分析证明两方案混合时判别式为负且无EP，从而建立金级/链级分类的穷尽性。
AI.result: 金级近EP处自旋翻转耦合具手性选择性，使非手性自旋阀输运在明确交叉点转变为纯手性输运；链级近EP处Petermann因子随链长呈幂律增长，指数受Rashba相干长度调控且对Rashba强度非单调，体现相干增强与Scheme A条件逐步失效的平衡。两类近EP均为理想两态EP的“ dressing”版本，观测EP与裸EP位置之比可度量合并对的离域化，提供无需拟合的机制诊断。
AI.conclusion: CISS结可作为研究非厄米谱物理的固态平台，金级与链级近EP提供了可区分、可诊断且具手性输运响应的两类机制。

title: Transport statistics in asymmetric coupled chaotic dots in series: Brownian motion model
summary: We study statistics of transport properties in a system of two quantum chaotic cavities coupled in series through a tunable junction and connected to reservoirs with asymmetric leads. Within the random matrix theory framework and in the absence of time-reversal symmetry, the scattering matrix S undergoes a crossover from two independent circular unitary ensembles to a single CUE as the inter-cavity coupling increases. Modeling this crossover using Dyson's Brownian motion approach, with the junction width acting as a time-like parameter, we derive closed-form expressions for the time-dependent averages and variances of conductance and shot noise power for arbitrary lead asymmetry. These analytical results reduce to known expressions in the symmetric and fully coupled limits. The mapping between the Brownian time parameter and the physical junction width is found to be observable-dependent, reflecting the different eigenfunction correlations probed by conductance and shot noise power, and this dependence is examined and separately calibrated for each observable. Validating against random-matrix simulations and tight-binding transport calculations using Kwant, we find quantitative agreement for ensemble-averaged observables throughout the crossover, while variances, being more sensitive to microscopic fluctuations, show deviations from the Brownian-motion predictions.

AI.tldr: 该文用Dyson Brownian motion描述两个量子混沌腔串联耦合时散射矩阵从两个独立CUE到单一CUE的交叉，并给出任意引线不对称下电导与散粒噪声的时变均值/方差闭式解。
AI.motivation: 研究可调结耦合的串联量子混沌腔中输运统计如何随耦合增强而演化，特别是在无时间反演对称性和任意引线不对称条件下电导与散粒噪声的交叉行为。
AI.method: 在随机矩阵理论框架下，将结宽作为类时间参数，用Dyson Brownian motion建模两个独立CUE到单一CUE的交叉；推导电导和散粒噪声功率的时间依赖均值与方差闭式表达式，并分别校准Brownian时间参数与物理结宽的映射；与随机矩阵模拟及Kwant紧束缚输运计算对比。
AI.result: 解析结果在对称和完全耦合极限下退化为已知表达式；系综平均观测量在整个交叉区与模拟定量一致；方差对微观涨落更敏感，出现偏离Brownian motion预测的现象；Brownian时间与物理结宽的映射依赖观测量，反映电导和散粒噪声探测的不同本征函数关联。
AI.conclusion: Dyson Brownian motion可有效描述串联混沌腔耦合交叉中的系综平均输运统计，但方差预测精度较低；需按观测量分别校准时间映射，并注意微观涨落对高阶统计量的影响。

title: Cu intercalation and field-driven filament formation in vertically aligned MoS$_2$ memristors
summary: Vertically-aligned MoS$_2$ films paired with a Cu top electrode have been used as electrochemical metallization cell memristor devices. The memristive switching has been attributed to the formation of conductive filaments, yet their exact structure has remained elusive. Here we carry out a multi-scale computational study of Cu intercalation, clustering, and field-driven dynamics to eventually model the filament formation under operating conditions. We use density-functional theory results to fine-tune a machine learning force field, and the most important physical phenomena are further distilled into multi-particle kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. By exhaustive enumeration of Cu intercalated structures, we find the most stable structure at MoS$_2$Cu$_{0.11}$ composition, with Cu atoms forming a dice lattice between the MoS$_2$ layers. These structures are shown to exhibit metallic character and can thus form conductive filaments under memristor operation. The simulated switching speed and threshold voltage agree well with the available experimental data. Our results give fundamental insights on the device operation mechanism and guidelines for maximizing switching speed and endurance.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过多尺度计算揭示了垂直取向MoS2薄膜/Cu顶电极电化学金属化忆阻器中Cu插层、团簇与场驱动动力学，并模拟导电细丝形成。
AI.motivation: 此类忆阻器的阻变通常归因于导电细丝形成，但细丝的确切原子结构不清楚，阻碍了对器件机理的理解及开关速度与耐久性的优化。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论校准机器学习力场，并将关键物理过程提炼为多粒子动力学蒙特卡洛模拟；通过穷举Cu插层结构研究稳定性，并模拟电场驱动下的Cu团簇与细丝形成。
AI.result: 发现最稳定结构为MoS2Cu0.11，Cu原子在MoS2层间形成骰子晶格；该结构呈金属性，可作为导电细丝；模拟的开关速度与阈值电压与现有实验数据吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了Cu插层MoS2忆阻器的器件工作机制与细丝形成机理，并为提升开关速度和耐久性提供设计准则。

title: Reconstructing chiral edge states via boundary dissipation
summary: Boundary dissipation can reshape the spatial profiles and decay properties of topological edge modes in Chern insulators. We develop a microscopic boundary-channel framework to explain their decay mechanisms and determine the effective decay rates in the weak- and strong-loss regimes. By retaining the lossy outer orbitals and a normalized edge state of the Hermitian inner system, we identify a directly coupled bright boundary channel, while incorporating the remaining inner states through a Feshbach self-energy. In the Qi--Wu--Zhang model, weak-loss decay is governed to leading order by the original edge state's probability weight on the lossy boundary, with coupling-induced corrections starting at cubic order. At strong loss, the reconstructed inner-edge state instead decays through virtual coupling to the damped bright channel, giving a rate proportional to the squared microscopic coupling and inversely proportional to the bare loss. The Haldane model shows that the same leading decay mechanism holds for a different intercell hopping structure, while additional matrix-valued self-energy feedback modifies the boundary spectrum at finite loss and shifts the exceptional-point threshold. These results provide a unified microscopic description of boundary-state reconstruction and its decay mechanisms, offering testable predictions to guide experiments in photonic crystals, phononic crystals, and topolectrical circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出微观边界通道框架，统一解释Chern绝缘体中边界耗散如何重构拓扑边缘态并决定其在弱损耗与强损耗区的衰减机制。
AI.motivation: 边界耗散会改变拓扑边缘模的空间分布与衰减性质，但其微观衰减机制及有效衰减率尚缺乏统一描述。
AI.method: 保留有损耗的外层轨道与Hermitian内禀体系的归一化边缘态，识别直接耦合的亮边界通道，并通过Feshbach自能纳入其余内部态；在Qi-Wu-Zhang模型和Haldane模型中分析弱/强损耗区的衰减率。
AI.result: 弱损耗下衰减率主阶由原边缘态在损耗边界上的概率权重决定，耦合修正从三阶开始；强损耗下重构的内边缘态通过虚耦合到阻尼亮通道衰减，速率正比于微观耦合平方、反比于裸损耗；Haldane模型保持相同主阶机制，但矩阵值自能反馈会修正有限损耗下的边界谱并移动奇异点阈值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出边界态重构及其衰减机制的统一微观图像，并提供可指导光子晶体、声子晶体和拓扑电路实验的可检验预测。

title: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in Luttinger liquids
summary: We develop the theory of hydrodynamic fluctuations for one-dimensional quantum liquids. At low temperatures the relaxation of interacting electrons in a single-channel wire separates into two classes: equilibration, which changes the numbers of right and left movers through backscattering and is exponentially slow, and thermalization, which redistributes energy and momentum at a fixed number of movers at a power-law rate. This separation of time scales gives the electron liquid a two-fluid description analogous to superfluid $^4$He, with the zero mode of the Luttinger liquid as the superfluid component and the gas of thermal excitations as the normal component. Using Onsager reciprocity and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, we add Langevin fluxes to the two-fluid hydrodynamic equations, including a mutual-friction noise generated by rare backscattering events that has no counterpart in helium. We apply the theory to Coulomb-coupled quantum wires and calculate the dynamic structure factors, which contain a second-sound peak next to the plasmon doublet; the Coulomb drag resistivity, where intrawire equilibration acts as a bottleneck and turns the hydrodynamic drag into an activated temperature dependence; and the near-field heat transfer between the wires. Mode frequencies, spectral weights, linewidths, and the crossover scales of the transport coefficients are expressed through the thermodynamic properties of the liquid and a few dissipative coefficients, providing spectroscopic and transport probes of two-fluid behavior in one-dimensional quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 作者建立了一维量子液体中流体力学涨落的理论，揭示低温度下电子液体因 equilibration 与 thermalization 时间尺度分离而呈现类似超流氦的两流体行为，并用于 Coulomb 耦合量子线的动态结构因子、Coulomb drag 与近场热输运。
AI.motivation: 一维相互作用电子在低温度下的弛豫包含改变左右 mover 数的背散射 equilibration 和固定 mover 数的能量/动量再分配 thermalization，二者速率差异使体系可能具有两流体描述；需要系统纳入热涨落与随机背散射噪声。
AI.method: 将 Luttinger 液体零模视为超流分量、热激发气体视为正常分量，利用 Onsager 倒易关系与涨落耗散定理在两流体流体力学方程中加入 Langevin 通量，并加入由稀有背散射产生的互摩擦噪声；随后应用于 Coulomb 耦合量子线计算动态结构因子、Coulomb drag 电阻率和近场热转移。
AI.result: 动态结构因子中出现等离激元双峰旁的第二声峰；Coulomb drag 中线内 equilibration 成为瓶颈，使 drag 呈激活型温度依赖；近场热转移也被计算。模式频率、谱权重、线宽和输运系数 crossover 尺度可由热力学性质与少数耗散系数表示。
AI.conclusion: 该理论给出一维量子系统中两流体行为的谱学与输运探针，并指出互摩擦噪声是区别于超流氦的关键新要素。

title: Electric Field-Induced Hole- and Electron-Type Flat Bands in Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene
summary: Application of a finite electric field and small twist angle between two graphene bilayers leads to widely tunable electronic structures that support emergent phenomena. Here, we measure the electronic structure of twisted double bilayer graphene with twist angles of 3.1$^{\circ}$ and 6.0$^{\circ}$ using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (microARPES) on \textit{in situ} gated samples. At a twist angle of 6.0$^{\circ}$, we find that the dispersion around the valence and conduction band extrema is unchanged compared to separate graphene bilayers, whereas electric field tunable hybridisation gaps and band flattening effects occur at higher binding energies. In the 3.1$^{\circ}$ structure, we find that the resulting superlattice drives dispersion changes around the valence and conduction band edges. Increasing the gate-induced doping in the bottom bilayer leads to the formation of flat bands between the valence band maximum in the bottom bilayer and conduction band minimum in the top bilayer. Our experiments establish combinations of twist angle and electric field that potentially support strong electron-hole excitations and that provide a benchmark for the theoretical description of moderately twisted double bilayer graphene.

AI.tldr: 利用原位门控微区角分辨光电子能谱测量3.1°和6.0°扭转双双层石墨烯，揭示扭转角与电场共同调控的能带杂化和平带行为。
AI.motivation: 有限电场与小扭转角可使双层石墨烯体系产生高度可调电子结构并支持涌现现象，需要实验直接测量扭转双双层石墨烯在门控下的电子结构。
AI.method: 对原位门控的扭转双双层石墨烯样品进行微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（microARPES）测量，比较3.1°和6.0°扭转角下的能带色散。
AI.result: 6.0°样品中价带和导带极值附近色散与独立双层石墨烯相同，但更高结合能处出现电场可调杂化隙和能带平坦化；3.1°样品中超晶格改变价带和导带边缘附近色散；增加底层门控掺杂可在底双层价带顶与顶双层导带底之间形成平带。
AI.conclusion: 实验确定了可潜在支持强电子-空穴激发的扭转角与电场组合，并为中等扭转双双层石墨烯的理论描述提供基准。

title: Evaluation of upper-scale mechanical parameters of particulate aluminum-based nanocomposites from molecular simulations
summary: This paper focuses on the numerical and analytical determination of the mechanical parameters of aluminum-matrix nanocomposites using atomistic-scale simulations within a multiscale modeling framework. Molecular statics simulations were employed to evaluate the tensile and compressive behavior of Al based composites reinforced with nanosized alumina particles. Two classes of atomistic models were investigated. First, a unit-cell model containing a single Al2O3 monocrystal embedded in an aluminum matrix was used to examine the influence of the volume fraction of the ceramic inclusion on the effective mechanical properties. Second, a polycrystalline RVE model comprising an alumina particle was analyzed to assess the effect of the number of Al grains on effective properties. For each case, the mechanical response was characterized by stress-strain curves, enabling the identification of upper-scale material parameters associated with the elastic regime (bulk, shear and Young's modulus) and the damage stage (ultimate strength, ultimate strain, and failure strain). The isotropized elastic constants evaluated from molecular simulations were compared with classical Voigt-Reuss-Hill bounds to assess their applicability in the elastic regime. Finally, atomistic-scale simulation outputs provided insight into the dominant deformation/damage mechanisms (brittle versus ductile) and fracture modes (transgranular versus intergranular).

AI.tldr: 该文在多尺度建模框架下采用原子尺度分子静力学模拟，确定Al基纳米复合材料的力学参数，并分析Al2O3体积分数、Al晶粒数及变形/损伤机制。
AI.motivation: 为铝基纳米复合材料的多尺度建模提供可靠的原子尺度力学参数，并评估经典弹性界限及陶瓷增强相和微观结构对有效性能的影响。
AI.method: 采用分子静力学模拟研究纳米Al2O3增强Al基复合材料的拉伸与压缩行为；构建两类模型：含单个Al2O3单晶的单元胞模型用于考察陶瓷夹杂体积分数的影响，含Al2O3颗粒的多晶RVE模型用于考察Al晶粒数的影响；由应力-应变曲线识别弹性区参数（体积模量、剪切模量、杨氏模量）和损伤阶段参数（极限强度、极限应变、失效应变），并将各向同性化弹性常数与Voigt-Reuss-Hill界限比较。
AI.result: 获得了不同模型的有效力学响应和上尺度材料参数；分子模拟得到的各向同性弹性常数与Voigt-Reuss-Hill界限进行了对比以评估其在弹性区的适用性；模拟结果揭示以脆性还是韧性为主的变形/损伤机制以及穿晶或沿晶断裂模式。
AI.conclusion: 原子尺度模拟可为铝基纳米复合材料多尺度建模提供关键力学参数和损伤/断裂机制认识，但弹性常数的上限/下限适用性需结合模拟结果评估。

title: Three-dimensional quantum Hall insulators in magnetic pyrochlore systems
summary: We show that a class of pyrochlore materials provides a route to realize 3D Quantum Hall insulators, based on magnetic texture and flat band interference. We study itinerant electrons on a pyrochlore lattice Kondo-coupled to localized moments living on another interpenetrating pyrochlore lattice, with the moments forming a field-selected three-in/one-out texture. The noncoplanar texture generates complex spin-dependent hopping amplitudes and unequal local exchange energies, reconstructing the compact-localized parent flat bands into narrow bands separated by a global three-dimensional gap. The low-energy states are concentrated predominantly on kagome planes within the three-dimensional lattice, reflecting the combined effects of quantum interference and the texture-induced sublattice potential. When the lowest band is fully occupied, the response is characterized by a Chern triplet $\mathbf{C}=(1,1,1)$ and reciprocal Hall vector $\mathbf{G}_{\mathrm{H}}=(2\pi/a)(1,1,1)$, giving $\sigma_{yz}=\sigma_{zx}=\sigma_{xy}=e^2/(ha)$. The quantized bulk Hall response enforces chiral surface spectral flow, visible as noncontractible Fermi loops at the surface. Our work opens a new direction in the search for three-dimensional quantum Hall physics in magnetic pyrochlore systems, and suggests a broad design principle based on the interplay of magnetic texture and flat-band interference.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在磁性烧绿石材料中利用磁结构与平带干涉实现三维量子霍尔绝缘体。
AI.motivation: 三维量子霍尔物理的实现路径和材料平台仍有限，作者希望建立基于磁性结构与平带干涉的通用设计原则。
AI.method: 研究烧绿石晶格上的巡游电子与另一套互穿烧绿石晶格上的局域磁矩通过Kondo耦合相互作用；场选的三入一出非共面磁结构产生复数的自旋相关跃迁振幅和局域交换能不均，将紧致局域母平带重构为被全局三维能隙分隔的窄带，低能态主要局域在三维晶格内的kagome面。
AI.result: 当最低带被完全占据时，体系表现为陈数三元组 C=(1,1,1) 和倒空间霍尔矢量 G_H=(2π/a)(1,1,1)，给出 σ_yz=σ_zx=σ_xy=e^2/(ha)；量子化体霍尔响应导致手征表面谱流，并表现为表面上的不可收缩费米环。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在磁性烧绿石体系中寻找三维量子霍尔物理开辟新方向，并提出基于磁结构与平带干涉相互作用的广泛设计原则。

title: Beyond Geometry: Hole-Edge Atomic Configuration as a Design Variable in Graphyne Kirigami
summary: Kirigami-inspired cuts are an established route to stretchability in two-dimensional materials. At the nanoscale, however, cut edges are not purely geometric: they comprise discrete atomic configurations that can alter the mechanical response. In graphene, a given cut geometry fixes the edge structure; graphyne, a porous carbon allotrope with an intrinsic band gap, lifts this constraint, as identical cut geometries can yield distinct hole-edge configurations. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we report the first atomistic study of $\gamma$-graphyne kirigami (GYK), and compared with graphene kirigami. GYK reaches yield strains up to 9.6 times that of pristine $\gamma$-graphyne, with a response governed by both cut geometry and local hole-edge structure. Removing just two carbon atoms at selected edge sites further raises the yield strain by up to 35%, with little loss of yield stress. These findings identify hole-edge atomic configuration as an additional design parameter, expanding the design space for nanoscale kirigami engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文用分子动力学首次原子尺度研究γ-石墨炔剪纸（GYK），并与石墨烯剪纸对比，发现孔边原子构型是调控纳米剪纸力学响应的重要附加设计参数。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度剪纸切口边缘由离散原子构型组成，并非纯几何边界；石墨烯中切口几何决定边缘结构，而γ-石墨炔允许相同切口几何产生不同孔边构型，因此需研究其对力学响应的影响。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学模拟，对γ-石墨炔剪纸（GYK）进行首次原子尺度研究，并与石墨烯剪纸进行对比。
AI.result: GYK的屈服应变最高可达原始γ-石墨炔的9.6倍，其响应由切口几何和局部孔边结构共同决定；在选定边缘位点仅移除两个碳原子，可使屈服应变进一步提高最多35%，且屈服应力损失很小。
AI.conclusion: 孔边原子构型可作为额外设计参数，拓展纳米尺度剪纸工程的设计空间。

title: Learning Multiscale Dynamics of Nanoparticle Self-Assembly
summary: Nanoparticle self-assembly offers a powerful route to programmable functional materials, but its dynamics remain difficult to understand because they arise from multiscale, many-body, and environment-dependent interactions. Liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy (LPTEM) enables real-time observation of these dynamics, yet extracting the underlying physical laws from highly stochastic trajectories remains a significant challenge. Here we develop a physics-informed, time-varying autoregressive framework that learns multiscale self-assembly dynamics directly from LPTEM videos. Continuous Eulerian fields with local density and orientational order are coarse-grained from individual video frames and evolved by a sparse, nearest-neighbor operator optimized over a constrained matrix manifold. This interpretable approach captures long-time large scale phase transitions by tracking operator volatility over time, and short-timescale local evolution and transport rules. Crucially, we extract the underlying partial differential equations, where expected symmetries naturally emerge, enabling the direct inference of fundamental coefficients. Our framework provides a robust, computationally efficient tool for discovering hidden physical mechanisms from observational data, opening a path toward the predictive design of self-assembled nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出物理信息驱动的时变自回归框架，从液相透射电镜视频中学习纳米颗粒多尺度自组装动力学。
AI.motivation: 纳米颗粒自组装动力学具有多尺度、多体和环境依赖特征，难以理解；LPTEM可实时观测，但从高随机性轨迹中提取物理规律仍具挑战。
AI.method: 将视频帧粗粒化为包含局部密度与取向序的连续欧拉场，并用在约束矩阵流形上优化的稀疏最近邻算子演化这些场；通过跟踪算子随时间波动捕捉长期大尺度相变，同时学习短时局部演化与输运规则，并提取具有自然对称性的偏微分方程以推断基本系数。
AI.result: 该框架能够捕捉长时间大尺度相变和短时间局部演化规则，并成功提取 underlying PDE 及其基本系数。
AI.conclusion: 该可解释、计算高效的方法可从观测数据中发现隐藏物理机制，为自组装纳米结构的预测性设计提供途径。

title: Spin-Charge Conversion in an Epitaxial Kagome Flat-Band Metal
summary: The formation of topological flat bands near the Fermi level in kagome-structured metals has generated substantial research interest. One key consequence of this electronic structure is the strong anisotropy in charge transport, such as the significantly higher in-plane resistivity relative to the out-of-plane direction. However, the spin transport properties of these flat-band kagome metals are still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate spin-charge conversion in CoSn, a representative flat-band kagome metal. Scanning tunneling microscopy is employed to image the CoSn surface with atomic resolution, and $dI/dV$ spectroscopy shows clear signatures of the flat bands. Using magneto-optical techniques, we quantify the spin-orbit torque (SOT) in bilayers of ferromagnetic nickel (Ni) and c-plane CoSn thin films. We find a large effective spin Hall angle of $\theta_{SH} = 0.484 \pm 0.005$ within the CoSn layers, significantly exceeding the value measured for Pt of $\theta_{SH} = 0.0436 \pm 0.0003$ in Ni/Pt bilayers. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide a microscopic understanding of the intrinsic spin Hall effect in CoSn, elucidating the sources of Berry curvature in momentum space. These findings establish kagome metals as promising materials for efficient spin-charge conversion and low-power spintronics.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究平带kagome金属CoSn中的自旋-电荷转换，在Ni/CoSn双层中测得显著增强的自旋轨道力矩与大的有效自旋霍尔角，并结合DFT揭示其内禀自旋霍尔效应和Berry曲率来源。
AI.motivation: kagome金属费米能级附近的拓扑平带会导致强各向异性电荷输运，但其自旋输运性质，尤其是自旋-电荷转换，仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜对CoSn表面进行原子级成像，并用dI/dV谱表征平带；利用磁光技术定量测量Ni/CoSn双层中的自旋轨道力矩；结合密度泛函理论计算分析CoSn的内禀自旋霍尔效应及动量空间Berry曲率来源。
AI.result: 在CoSn层中获得大的有效自旋霍尔角θ_SH = 0.484 ± 0.005，显著高于Ni/Pt双层中Pt的θ_SH = 0.0436 ± 0.0003。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立kagome金属是实现高效自旋-电荷转换和低功耗自旋电子学的有前景材料体系。

title: Spin-polarized tunneling from a Kondo insulator: equilibrium surface magnetism versus magneto-electric response in SmB$_6$
summary: We theoretically analyze the spin-polarized tunneling between SmB$_6$ tip and the bicollinear antiferromagnet Fe$_{1+x}$Te. The emergence of magnetic contrast in tunneling requires time-reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of the tip. The magnetic contrast part of the tunneling conductance then has two contributions: the first one originates from the magnetic moment due to the equilibrium long-range order on the surface, while the other is governed by the magnetic moment induced by the electric field of the junction through the surface magneto-electric effect. We show that the ratio of the equilibrium moment to the response extracted near zero bias equals, up to the sign, twice the bias at which the contrast changes sign, independently of the relative strength of the two mechanisms, so that this ratio itself does not measure the strength of the magneto-electric effect. We find that within the experimental energy window $|eV|\lesssim10$~meV the {bias-dependent} field-induced contribution is at most a few percent of the equilibrium one, and the two become comparable only at biases of order $100$~meV or higher. The ratio of the field-induced to the equilibrium contribution is inversely proportional to the distance between the tip and the substrate.

AI.tldr: 该文理论分析了SmB6针尖与双共线反铁磁Fe1+xTe之间的自旋极化隧穿，区分了表面平衡磁矩与表面磁电效应诱导磁矩对磁隧穿电导的贡献。
AI.motivation: 理解SmB6针尖隧道结中磁对比的来源，并判断磁电效应在实验能量窗口内是否显著、能否由磁对比比值直接测量。
AI.method: 基于时间反演对称性破缺要求，将磁对比电导分解为表面平衡长程磁序贡献和结电场通过表面磁电效应诱导磁矩的贡献，并分析二者随偏压及针尖-衬底距离的变化。
AI.result: 平衡磁矩与近零偏压响应之比（至多差一符号）等于磁对比变号偏压的两倍，且与两种机制相对强度无关；在|eV|≤10 meV内，场诱导贡献至多为平衡贡献的百分之几，二者仅在约100 meV或更高偏压时相当；场诱导与平衡贡献之比反比于针尖-衬底距离。
AI.conclusion: 该比值本身不能衡量磁电效应强度；在实验低能窗口内磁对比主要由平衡表面磁序主导，磁电场诱导贡献较小且随距离衰减。

title: Coulomb Crystallization in Free Electron Beams
summary: Classical Coulomb crystals and quantum Wigner crystals typically arise when repulsive interactions order like-charged particles in spatially confined environments. Here, we show that transient crystallization can also emerge in freely propagating electron pulses without external trapping. Experimentally, we use a transmission electron microscope to measure number-resolved energy correlations in photoemitted pulses containing up to nine electrons, revealing strong correlations at small particle numbers that progressively disappear in the pulse interior as the number increases. To explain these observations, we combine many-body simulations with a one-dimensional statistical-mechanical model, showing that the leading and trailing electrons generate a self-induced longitudinal potential that transiently confines the inner particles, enabling the formation of an ordered chain during propagation. The resulting crystallization phase diagram reveals how many-body ordering dynamics can be understood in terms of evolving macroscopic beam properties, namely its geometry and the ratio of the mean Coulomb interaction energy to the longitudinal thermal energy. Extending this framework, we theoretically demonstrate that weak transverse guiding through electrostatic or optical ponderomotive forces can sustain crystallization at larger particle numbers and predict spontaneous longitudinal periodic bunching in continuous electron beams. Our results identify conditions under which stochastic Coulomb interactions can be harnessed to generate self-structured, strongly correlated electron beams in both pulsed and continuous regimes.

AI.tldr: 自由传播的电子脉冲无需外势阱即可出现瞬态库仑结晶：脉冲首尾电子产生自诱导纵向势，短暂约束内部电子形成有序链；弱横向导引可在大粒子数下维持结晶，并在连续束中预测纵向周期聚束。
AI.motivation: 经典库仑晶体和量子维格纳晶体通常依赖空间约束下的排斥相互作用实现有序化；本文探究无外部陷阱的自由传播电子脉冲是否也能发生瞬态结晶，并揭示其多体有序机制。
AI.method: 利用透射电子显微镜测量最多含9个电子的光发射脉冲中的数目分辨能量关联；结合多体模拟与一维统计力学模型解释关联随粒子数变化；构建结晶相图，以束流几何及平均库仑相互作用能与纵向热能之比刻画有序动力学；理论上分析静电或光驻极体（ponderomotive）弱横向导引的影响。
AI.result: 小粒子数下观察到强能量关联，随脉冲内部粒子数增加关联逐渐消失；模型表明首尾电子形成自诱导纵向势并瞬态约束内部电子，从而在传播中形成有序链；相图将多体有序与宏观束流参量联系起来；弱横向导引可在更大粒子数下维持结晶，并预测连续电子束中自发纵向周期聚束。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在脉冲和连续束体系中，通过调控束流几何及库仑相互作用与纵向热能之比，可利用随机库仑相互作用产生自结构化、强关联的电子束，为无外阱电子束结晶与聚束提供理论条件。

title: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
summary: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，将成分-组织-性能关系、加工路线与可持续性约束结合，用于在真实约束下设计可持续镁合金。
AI.motivation: 可持续合金设计需同时兼顾高性能与原料稀缺性/波动性、加工与能耗、法规阈值和经济性等现实约束，超越传统以性能为中心的框架，并处理性能-成本-排放权衡及可持续生产路径。
AI.method: 构建物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，融合结构-性能基础关系、加工路线和可持续性准则；由成分-微观组织预测性能，并在可持续性约束下推断加工路线。以镁合金为验证对象，基于基准数据集系统探索可行成分与微观组织，构建包含数百万候选合金的数字库，并综合性能、成本和碳排放筛选。
AI.result: 识别出两种克服传统性能-成本-排放权衡的可持续镁合金方案：含稀土合金在成本和排放相当条件下，屈服强度和抗拉强度分别较同族合金提高72.8%和61.1%；无稀土合金在不牺牲力学性能情况下，较原生原料对应方案分别降低成本和碳排放40.4%和88.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个通用、物理信息驱动且可量化的框架，可在现实约束下设计可持续合金。

title: Amorphization-Depth-Dependent Bismuth Redistribution and Activation in Silicon for Quantum Devices
summary: Near-surface bismuth donors are promising for silicon quantum devices because of their rich electron-nuclear spin structure and long spin coherence, but their electrical activation is strongly influenced by implantation-induced amorphization. We compare redistribution and electrical activation of 20 keV Bi implanted directly into Si and after Si preamorphization. The two routes produce amorphous-layer depths of approximately 47 nm and 177 +/- 15 nm, respectively. After annealing at 650 C for 300 s, Rutherford backscattering spectrometry and channeling reveal comparable substitutional Bi fractions of 91 +/- 2% and 89 +/- 4%, whereas Hall measurements indicate Hall-derived electrical activation yields of approximately 60% and 90%, respectively. Depth-resolved ion-scattering analysis reveals a buried Bi-related feature at or beyond the initial amorphous/crystalline interface, within the end-of-range region, together with increasing surface segregation at higher annealing temperatures. The buried feature is consistent with trapping near residual end-of-range defects. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and low-temperature photoluminescence on the Bi-only sample reveal no resolvable Bi-oxide contribution and a donor-related optical signature, respectively. These results show that amorphization depth and regrowth geometry govern Bi redistribution and influence electrical activation beyond substitutional incorporation alone.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了20 keV Bi直接注入Si与Si预非晶化后再注入Bi两条路径，发现非晶层深度和再生长几何会显著影响Bi的再分布与电激活，而不仅取决于替位 incorporation。
AI.motivation: 近表面Bi施主在Si量子器件中具有丰富电子-核自旋结构和长自旋相干时间，但注入诱导非晶化会强烈影响其电激活，因此需要理解不同注入/预非晶化路线下的再分布与激活机制。
AI.method: 对20 keV Bi直接注入Si及Si预非晶化后注入样品进行比较；测量非晶层深度；650 C、300 s退火后用Rutherford背散射/沟道分析替位Bi分数，用Hall测量电激活率，并用深度分辨离子散射、XPS和低温光致发光分析Bi分布、化学态与施主光学特征。
AI.result: 直接注入与预非晶化样品的非晶层深度分别约47 nm和177±15 nm；退火后替位Bi分数分别为91±2%和89±4%，但Hall电激活率分别约60%和90%。深度分辨离子散射在初始非晶/晶体界面处或更深的end-of-range区发现埋藏Bi相关特征，且更高退火温度下表面偏析增强；XPS未分辨出Bi氧化物贡献，低温PL显示施主相关光学信号。
AI.conclusion: 非晶化深度与再生长几何决定Bi再分布，并在替位 incorporation 之外影响电激活；埋藏Bi特征与残余end-of-range缺陷陷阱有关。

title: STEM-Bank-26: An Open Dataset of Analytical Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Images and Spectra
summary: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) is a versatile, multi-modal method for studying materials at the nanoscale. It integrates multiple signal sources to provide atomic resolution imaging alongside spectroscopy for elemental composition and electronic structure. Despite its utility, few datasets spanning multiple years of data have been published. We introduce STEM-Bank-26, a 929 GB open dataset of 37,921 STEM images that spans 1,095 material samples across 1,499 sessions and includes energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) or electron-energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) data for 65.5% of sessions. We extract microscope control trajectories by comparing metadata between sequential images and provide tools for building similar datasets from archival data. To our knowledge, this is the largest openly available dataset that integrates experimental STEM, EDS and EELS data across a broad distribution of samples and sessions.

AI.tldr: 该文发布 STEM-Bank-26：一个 929 GB、包含 37,921 张 STEM 图像、覆盖 1,095 个材料样品和 1,499 次实验会话的开放数据集，其中 65.5% 的会话含 EDS 或 EELS 数据。
AI.motivation: STEM 可结合成像与谱学在纳米尺度表征材料，但公开的跨多年、多模态 STEM 数据集很少，限制了数据驱动研究和方法复现。
AI.method: 构建并开放 STEM-Bank-26 数据集，整合实验 STEM 图像及 EDS/EELS 谱学数据；通过比较连续图像的元数据提取显微镜控制轨迹，并提供从存档数据构建类似数据集的工具。
AI.result: 数据集规模为 929 GB、37,921 张 STEM 图像，覆盖 1,095 个材料样品、1,499 次会话，65.5% 的会话包含 EDS 或 EELS 数据；据作者所知，这是目前公开可用的最大规模、跨广泛样品和会话整合 STEM、EDS 与 EELS 实验数据的数据集。
AI.conclusion: STEM-Bank-26 为纳米材料多模态 STEM 表征提供了大规模开放数据资源，并支持显微控制轨迹分析和类似档案数据集的构建。

title: A Hybrid Brownian Dynamics-kinetic Monte Carlo Framework for Coupled Magnetic and Rotational Dynamics of Nanoparticles
summary: Simulating the coupled magnetic and rotational dynamics of suspended magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) over experimentally relevant timescales remains computationally demanding, particularly under low-frequency alternating magnetic fields. Here, we develop a hybrid Brownian Dynamics--kinetic Monte Carlo (BD--kMC) framework that combines thermally activated magnetic switching with particle rotation while retaining local fluctuations of the magnetic moment. These fluctuations are incorporated through Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, allowing the moment to depart from the energy minima and thereby capturing the thermally averaged anisotropy torque that governs particle rotation. To preserve the distinction between local fluctuations and magnetic reversals, a barrier-trapping criterion confines MC trial moves to the current energy well, leaving thermally activated switching to the kMC process. For non-interacting single-domain MNPs, comparison with stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) simulations demonstrates agreement in the equilibrium torque and stationary easy-axis orientation, including the field-driven transition from predominantly perpendicular to parallel alignment. The resulting BD--kMC framework provides an efficient approach to coupled magnetic and Brownian Dynamics, reducing the computational cost of exploring the long timescales relevant to low-frequency magnetic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合Brownian Dynamics--kinetic Monte Carlo框架，用于高效模拟悬浮磁性纳米颗粒在低频交变磁场下的磁化与转动耦合动力学。
AI.motivation: 实验相关时间尺度上，尤其低频交变磁场下，耦合磁矩与颗粒转动的模拟计算成本高，需要兼顾热涨落、磁翻转和颗粒旋转的高效方法。
AI.method: 将热激活磁翻转的kMC与颗粒转动的BD结合，并用Metropolis MC采样磁矩局域涨落，使磁矩可偏离能量极小值以捕捉热平均各向异性力矩；通过barrier-trapping判据将MC试探限制在当前能谷，磁翻转交由kMC处理。
AI.result: 对非相互作用单畴MNPs，与随机LLG模拟相比，平衡力矩和稳态易轴取向一致，包括场驱动下由主要垂直取向向平行取向的转变。
AI.conclusion: BD--kMC框架为耦合磁性与Brownian动力学提供高效模拟途径，可降低探索低频磁应用相关长时程的计算成本。

title: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
summary: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at $O(N)$ cost for $N$ atoms, against $O(N\log N)$ on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.

AI.tldr: UniTB 是一个融合 DFTB 物理先验与深度学习的通用 E(3) 等变哈密顿量框架，可在跨化学组分和未训练的非晶体系中保持下游物理性质，并实现大规模材料筛选。
AI.motivation: DFT 计算成本限制大超胞计算与材料筛选；现有机器学习哈密顿量通常体系特定，亟需能覆盖新组分、无序固体、保持物理性质且对大体系廉价的通用模型。
AI.method: UniTB 以密度泛函紧束缚理论为物理先验，用深度学习校正先验哈密顿量；采用由先验路由的专家混合网络和自洽电荷紧束缚式电荷均衡头，并通过投影限制能带偏移以抑制虚假态；提供快速 SO(2) 张量积 GPU 内核。UniTB-Flash 用双中心表以 O(N) 构造先验，替代网格上的 O(N log N)。
AI.result: 在 29,242 个晶体上训练，UniTB 在覆盖 68 种元素的非磁测试晶体上达到 0.48 meV 矩阵元误差；未用非晶数据训练时，两个模型对非晶 Ge-Sb-Te 的光学和电导率与 DFT 一致；UniTB-Flash 候选排序与 UniTB 无显著差异，后者性质值更准确；二者联合筛选了 16,195 个晶体用于五个工业相关应用领域。
AI.conclusion: UniTB 展示了通用、等变、物理约束的机器学习哈密顿量在大规模材料筛选中的可行性，并兼顾跨化学泛化、非晶适用性、下游物理性质保真度与大体系计算效率。

title: Anisotropic Structural and Magnetic Response in Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$: Al-Sublattice Reconstruction upon Sm Substitution
summary: Chemical pressure plays a critical role in determining the crystal structures and physical properties of intermetallic compounds. Here, we report the synthesis, crystal structure, and physical properties of Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$, a structural analog of UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$, in which the smaller 5f uranium atoms are replaced by larger 4f samarium atoms. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a tetragonal $\sqrt{2}\times\sqrt{2}\times1$ superstructure with space group $P\bar{4}2_1m$, derived from a UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$-like average structure with space group $P4_2/nmc$. Comparison with UIr$_4$Al$_{15}$ shows that chemical pressure from U-to-Sm substitution produces a strongly anisotropic structural response rather than a uniform expansion of the Ir-Al framework. While one Ir coordination environment undergoes only modest changes, the other exhibits substantial local rearrangement. The Al sublattice primarily accommodates these structural distortions, with selected Al sites showing positional splitting, anisotropic atomic displacement ellipsoids, and partial occupancies, resulting in an Al-rich composition of approximately Sm$_2$Ir$_8$Al$_{31}$. Magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a direction dependence, including a broad anomaly near 50 K for selected magnetic-field orientations. However, the absence of corresponding anomalies in heat capacity, electrical resistivity, and lattice parameters suggests that this feature is more consistent with an anisotropic magnetic crossover than a bulk thermodynamic phase transition. These results highlight how chemical substitution at the f-element site can induce Al-sublattice reconstruction and modify the magnetic response within a closely related Ir-Al structural framework.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了Sm2Ir8Al31的合成、晶体结构与物理性质，揭示用较大的4f Sm替代较小的5f U后，化学压力诱导Ir-Al框架发生强各向异性畸变和Al亚晶格重构，并改变磁性响应。
AI.motivation: 化学压力对金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质具有关键作用；作者以UIr4Al15为参照，通过U→Sm替代研究f位元素尺寸变化对密切相关的Ir-Al结构框架及磁性的影响。
AI.method: 采用单晶X射线衍射解析结构，并结合磁化率、热容、电阻率和晶格参数测量表征物理性质；将Sm2Ir8Al31与UIr4Al15进行结构对比。
AI.result: Sm2Ir8Al31为四方√2×√2×1超结构，空间群P-42_1m，来源于P4_2/nmc平均结构；U→Sm替代引起非均匀膨胀和强各向异性响应，一个Ir配位环境变化较小，另一个发生显著局域重排，Al亚晶格通过位置劈裂、各向异性原子位移椭球和部分占据容纳畸变，形成约Sm2Ir8Al31的富Al成分。磁化率呈方向依赖，并在约50 K出现宽异常，但热容、电阻率和晶格参数无对应异常。
AI.conclusion: 约50 K的磁化率异常更符合各向异性磁交叉而非体热力学相变；f位化学替代可诱导Al亚晶格重构并在相近Ir-Al结构框架内调控磁性响应。

title: Learning the Chronology of Materials Discovery for Synthesizability Prediction
summary: High-throughput computational and generative approaches are proposing candidate materials far faster than they can be synthesized, making it increasingly important to identify which hypothetical materials are likely to be experimentally realizable. Positive-unlabeled (PU) learning has emerged as a representative framework for synthesizability prediction, yet existing approaches treat experimentally reported materials as a static collection, overlooking the historical trajectory of materials discovery and the diverse practical factors that have driven its progress. Here we introduce ChronoSyn, a chronology-aware machine learning model that jointly learns synthesizability and the relative reporting order of known materials through a shared composition representation. Incorporating discovery chronology provides additional supervision beyond conventional synthesizability labels, improving prediction performance and enabling ChronoSyn to identify experimentally realizable compositions more effectively than baseline models. Applied to approximately 50 million hypothetical compositions, ChronoSyn identifies chemically coherent high-scoring families that include experimentally reported compositions unseen during training. These results highlight the chronology of materials discovery as an informative learning signal and suggest that the path along which known materials were discovered can point the way to those that will be discovered in the future.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChronoSyn：利用材料发现时间顺序作为额外监督信号，联合学习可合成性与已知材料相对报道顺序，从而更有效预测假设材料的实验可实现性。
AI.motivation: 高通量计算与生成模型提出的候选材料远超可合成验证速度；现有正-未标记（PU）学习将实验已报道材料视为静态集合，忽略材料发现的历史轨迹及驱动发现的多样实际因素。
AI.method: ChronoSyn 是时间顺序感知的机器学习模型，通过共享的成分表示联合学习材料可合成性与已知材料的相对报道顺序；在传统可合成性标签之外引入发现时间顺序监督，并与基线模型比较。
AI.result: 在约5000万个假设成分上，ChronoSyn 比基线更有效识别实验可实现的成分，并发现化学上连贯的高分材料家族，其中包含训练中未见的实验已报道成分。
AI.conclusion: 材料发现的时间顺序是有信息量的学习信号；已知材料的发现路径可为预测未来将被发现的材料提供线索。

authors: Senfu Zhang (Key Laboratory of Magnetism and Magnetic Functional Materials
title: Confinement, registry and spin in chromium migration between graphene layers
summary: We compare the migration of a single Cr atom on monolayer graphene, between AB-stacked layers and between AA-stacked layers, with one first-principles protocol (PBE+D3(BJ), one cell family, registry anchors and spin-state search). We find three main results. First, on the surface and in the AB gallery Cr stays magnetic and moves almost freely. On the surface the C-C bridge is the minimum in 4x4 and 5x5 cells, and the highest point we sample on a hop lies 10 meV above it (5x5). In the AB gallery Cr sits on the inversion centres of the bilayer, which form a kagome net, and hops between them over 15 meV with a moment of about 4.32 $\mu_B$. Second, in the AA gallery the minimum is a nonmagnetic $\eta^6$-$\eta^6$ sandwich that pulls the layers together. Leaving it requires opening the gallery and switching Cr to a moment of 4-5 $\mu_B$, so we map the path with separately relaxed spin branches. The barrier estimate is 636 meV in a 3x3 cell but 260 and 185 meV in 5x5 cells with the far-field spacing pinned and free, and it is not yet converged. At 300 K, with equal prefactors and if the spin change is not rate-limiting, Cr hops between AA layers 3-4 orders of magnitude more slowly than between AB layers, using the 5x5 AA estimates and the 3x3 AB band. These AA numbers are specific to PBE+D3: an on-site U of 1.0 eV on Cr d already makes the magnetic states the AA ground state. Third, Cr binds 246-666 meV more strongly in AA than in AB registry, so the fast AB hop requires that the layers keep their Bernal registry around Cr.

AI.tldr: 单层石墨烯上单个 Cr 原子在 AB 与 AA 堆垛层间的迁移差异显著：AB 层间保持磁性且几乎自由迁移，AA 层间形成非磁性 η6-η6 夹心并伴随高迁移势垒。
AI.motivation: 厘清 Cr 原子在石墨烯表面及 AB/AA 层间的迁移行为、磁态与堆垛注册关系，为理解层间金属原子的扩散和稳定性提供第一性原理依据。
AI.method: 采用统一的第一性原理协议 PBE+D3(BJ)，固定一组晶胞家族，使用注册位点锚定并进行自旋态搜索；对 AA 路径分别弛豫不同自旋分支。
AI.result: 表面与 AB 层间 Cr 保持磁性并近似自由迁移：表面 C-C 桥为 4x4/5x5 晶胞中的最小值，跳跃最高点仅高约 10 meV（5x5）；AB 层间 Cr 位于双层反演中心形成的 kagome 网上，跳跃势垒约 15 meV，磁矩约 4.32 μB。AA 层间最小值为非磁性 η6-η6 夹心并拉近层间距；离开该态需打开层间并切换至 4-5 μB 磁态，势垒在 3x3 晶胞为 636 meV，在 5x5 晶胞远场间距固定/自由时分别为 260 和 185 meV，尚未收敛。300 K、等前因子且自旋变化非限速时，AA 层间跳跃比 AB 慢 3-4 个数量级。AA 结果对 PBE+D3 敏感：Cr d 轨道加 U=1.0 eV 即使磁性态成为 AA 基态。Cr 在 AA 注册中比 AB 强结合 246-666 meV。
AI.conclusion: AB 堆垛下 Cr 可快速层间迁移，但前提是 Cr 周围石墨烯层保持 Bernal 注册；AA 堆垛则因强结合的非磁性夹心态和自旋切换导致迁移显著受阻，且 AA 势垒与基态对计算方法和晶胞尺寸仍敏感。

title: Spin Rectification in Series and Parallel Networks of Ferromagnets
summary: We present the experimental study of spin rectification in parallel and series networks of ferromagnetic conductors. The networks were composed of Ni36Fe64 elements (wires) which, when subject to ferromagnetic resonance (FMR), develop a small spin-rectification photovoltage. We found that the effect of spin rectification can be modeled as an increase in resistance of the ferromagnetic elements and closely follows the usual dependence of total network resistance in series and parallel electric circuits: the total spin-rectification photovoltage in ferromagnetic wires connected in series is equal to the algebraic sum of contributions from individual wires, while in the parallel connection one needs to add the reciprocals of the individual contributions. Our results support a simple way to control and manipulate the magnitude of spin-rectification photovoltage in multi-element spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 研究了Ni36Fe64铁磁导线在并联和串联网络中的自旋整流效应，发现其光电压可由铁磁元件电阻增加模型描述，并遵循电路串并联电阻规律。
AI.motivation: 为了理解并控制多元件自旋电子器件中自旋整流光电压的大小，需要考察铁磁导体网络拓扑（串联/并联）对自旋整流贡献的影响。
AI.method: 制备由Ni36Fe64铁磁导线构成的并联和串联网络，在铁磁共振条件下测量自旋整流光电压，并将该效应建模为铁磁元件电阻的增加。
AI.result: 串联网络中总自旋整流光电压等于各导线贡献的代数和；并联网络中总贡献按各单独贡献的倒数相加，与常规串并联总电阻规律一致。
AI.conclusion: 自旋整流可等效为铁磁元件的电阻增加，且通过串联/并联网络设计可简单调控多元件自旋电子器件中的自旋整流光电压幅值。

title: Exciton-driven coherent dressing in transient absorption
summary: While coherent excitons have recently been observed to dress electronic states in time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (tr-ARPES), exciton-driven dressing in optical spectroscopy remains largely unexplored. This work develops a theoretical and computational approach to exciton-driven dressing effects in transient absorption spectroscopy in the time-dependent adiabatic GW formalism and derives two symmetry- and band topology-protected selections rules for exciton-dressed transient absorption, unique from tr-ARPES. We then numerically calculate exciton-dressed transient absorption spectra of monolayer MoS2 and demonstrate the selection rules and their lifting after symmetry breaking.

AI.tldr: 该工作在含时绝热GW框架下研究激子缀饰对瞬态吸收光谱的影响，推导出受对称性和能带拓扑保护的两条选择定则，并在单层MoS2中数值验证。
AI.motivation: 相干激子缀饰电子态已在时间与角度分辨光电子能谱中被观测，但光学光谱中的激子驱动缀饰效应仍基本未被探索。
AI.method: 发展基于含时绝热GW形式主义的理论与计算方法，用于瞬态吸收光谱中的激子驱动缀饰效应，并推导激子缀饰瞬态吸收的两条受对称性和能带拓扑保护的选择定则；随后数值计算单层MoS2的激子缀饰瞬态吸收光谱。
AI.result: 得到两条区别于tr-ARPES的激子缀饰瞬态吸收选择定则，并在单层MoS2光谱中验证这些定则及其在对称性破缺后被解除。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将激子缀饰效应拓展到光学光谱，建立了激子缀饰瞬态吸收的理论与计算框架，并揭示了受对称性和能带拓扑保护的选择定则。

title: Multiwavelength Photoluminescence as a Non-destructive Probe of Depth-Dependent UV Damage in Perovskite Semiconductors
summary: Buried interfaces play a critical role in the operational stability of perovskite optoelectronic devices, yet remain challenging to probe non-destructively. Here, we demonstrate a multiwavelength photoluminescence-based approach exploiting the wavelength-dependent absorption of perovskites, enabling fast, and non-destructive probing of depth-sensitive degradation behavior of perovskite devices under operational conditions. Using ultraviolet (UV) light-soaking with different indium tin oxide (ITO) modifiers as a test case, we employ wide-field photoluminescence (PL) imaging, time-resolved photoluminescence (trPL) and ideality factor measurements with different wavelength excitation to characterize degradation behavior of both perovskite thin films and photovoltaic devices under UV soaking. Using only nondestructive characterization, we show that UV-induced degradation in p-i-n perovskite solar cells occurs preferentially at the HTL interface, adversely affecting device stability, consistent with ex-situ destructive tests. Our results also show that modifying the buried interface with 3-mercaptopropyltrimethoxysilane reduces UV-induced damage at the buried interface, thus improving the UV stability of both perovskite films and devices. This work establishes a fast, non-destructive strategy to screen depth-dependent degradation in perovskite devices, offering insights for interface design and stability optimization.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种基于多波长光致发光（PL）的非破坏性方法，利用钙钛矿波长依赖吸收实现运行条件下埋底界面深度分辨的降解探测，并在UV光照的p-i-n钙钛矿太阳能电池中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 埋底界面对钙钛矿光电器件运行稳定性至关重要，但现有手段难以非破坏性地探测其降解行为，因此需要一种快速、无损且具有深度敏感性的表征策略。
AI.method: 以不同ITO修饰层和紫外（UV）光浸泡为测试场景，采用宽场PL成像、时间分辨PL（trPL）以及不同波长激发下的理想因子测量，对钙钛矿薄膜和光伏器件在UV浸泡下的降解行为进行多波长、深度敏感表征，并与破坏性测试结果对照。
AI.result: 仅通过非破坏性表征发现，p-i-n钙钛矿太阳能电池中的UV诱导降解优先发生在空穴传输层（HTL）界面并损害器件稳定性，与离位破坏性测试一致；用3-巯丙基三甲氧基硅烷（MPTMS）修饰埋底界面可减少埋底界面的UV诱导损伤，从而提升钙钛矿薄膜和器件的UV稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一种快速、非破坏性的策略用于筛选钙钛矿器件中的深度相关降解行为，为埋底界面设计和稳定性优化提供了重要依据。

title: Oxygen partial pressure induced dielectric phase evolution in PLD deposited Barium Strontium Titanate thin films
summary: Barium Strontium Titanate ((BaxSr1-x)TiO3, BST) thin films are amongst the most extensively studied dielectric alloys over the last decade. This is due to the tunability of the dielectric constant and dissipation factor in the underlying ferroelectric and paraelectric states. One important feature of BST is that the competition between the ferroelectric BaTiO3 and the paraelectric SrTiO3 parent phases can be tuned by the A-site alloy concentration, opening a platform for exploring dielectric phase competition. However, the understanding of the interplay between and establishing the control of the dielectric phase from thin film deposition parameters has not been sufficiently reported in the literature. Here, we synthesized a series of SrRuO3/BST/SrRuO3 epitaxial thin film heterostructures by Pulsed Laser Deposition (PLD) from a (Ba0.9Sr0.1)TiO3 target under systematic variation of the oxygen partial pressure during the BST deposition. We mapped the dielectric phase of the film to the oxygen growth pressure, film composition, and film crystal structure. A ferroelectric, relaxor-like, or paraelectric phase can be obtained with relatively moderate change in oxygen growth pressure.
