Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) analysis further indicates that this pressure-dependent phase evolution is accompanied by a structural transition of the BST lattice from tetragonal toward a nearly cubic phase, with the latter corresponding to the relaxor-like state. The control of the dielectric phase opens a pathway to study phase evolution and enable future computing technologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调控PLD沉积BST薄膜时的氧分压，在SrRuO3/BST/SrRuO3外延异质结中实现了铁电、弛豫型铁电和顺电相的可控切换，并关联到晶格由四方相向近立方相的结构转变。
AI.motivation: BST的介电常数和损耗可通过铁电/顺电相竞争调控，且A位合金浓度可调节BaTiO3与SrTiO3母相竞争；但薄膜沉积参数如何影响并控制介电相仍缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 以(Ba0.9Sr0.1)TiO3靶材，采用脉冲激光沉积制备SrRuO3/BST/SrRuO3外延薄膜异质结，系统改变BST沉积过程中的氧分压，并结合介电表征、成分与晶体结构分析及STEM，建立氧分压-成分-结构-介电相的映射关系。
AI.result: 氧分压适度变化即可使BST呈现铁电相、弛豫型相或顺电相；STEM表明该相演化伴随BST晶格从四方相向近立方相转变，近立方相对应弛豫型状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过氧生长压力可有效控制BST外延薄膜的介电相，为研究介电相演化及发展未来计算技术提供了材料调控路径。

title: First-principles-based search for emergent topological spin textures in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
summary: Topological spin textures such as skyrmions and bimerons offer rich physical functionalities and strong potential for future spin-based technologies. Identifying materials that host such emergent magnetic states, however, remains challenging due to the complex interplay between microscopic magnetic interactions and large-scale spin textures. Here, using a multiscale first-principles discovery framework, we identify a broad class of two-dimensional materials that stabilize nontrivial spin textures. The framework integrates relativistic density functional theory, magnetic force theory, and atomistic spin-dynamics simulations, enabling a direct connection between electronic interactions and emergent magnetic textures and allowing efficient screening of systems with large magnetic unit cells and competing exchange interactions. Applying this approach, we systematically screen 312 monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides across 1T and 2H phases of 3d, 4d, and 5d transition metals. We uncover a diverse set of emergent spin textures, including skyrmions, bimerons, and complex domain states, and clarify their distinct stabilization mechanisms driven by exchange interactions, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, and magnetic frustration. These results identify promising candidate materials for topological spin textures and establish a transferable computational framework for accelerating materials discovery of complex magnetic states in two dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出多尺度第一性原理发现框架，系统筛选312种单层过渡金属二硫属化物，识别可稳定斯格明子、双半子及复杂畴态等拓扑自旋织构的二维材料。
AI.motivation: 拓扑自旋织构（如斯格明子和双半子）具有丰富物理功能与自旋技术潜力，但微观磁相互作用与宏观自旋织构之间复杂耦合使候选材料识别困难。
AI.method: 构建集成相对论密度泛函理论、磁力理论和原子尺度自旋动力学模拟的多尺度第一性原理框架，将电子相互作用与涌现磁织构直接关联，并高效筛选具有大磁单胞和竞争交换作用的体系；应用于1T和2H相、3d/4d/5d过渡金属的312种单层过渡金属二硫属化物。
AI.result: 发现包括斯格明子、双半子和复杂畴态在内的多种涌现自旋织构，并阐明由交换相互作用、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和磁阻挫驱动的不同稳定机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出拓扑自旋织构的有前景候选材料，并建立可迁移的计算框架，以加速二维复杂磁态的材料发现。

title: Comprehensive QM/ML Study of Dislocation Loop Line Segments in {\alpha}-Zr Part I: <a> Loop Core Geometries, Solute Binding, and Transition Barriers
summary: Zr cladding alloys in nuclear reactors are exposed to high neutron fluxes, making irradiation-induced defects and solute segregation central to understanding their in-service behaviour. Dislocation cores involve short-range chemistry and long-range elastic fields, which are difficult to describe simultaneously using conventional atomistic methods. Using a hybrid quantum mechanics/machine learning (QM/ML) framework, this part of work examines prismatic <a> loops in hcp {\alpha}-Zr. All three loop variants are considered, including faulted and perfect, interstitial- and vacancy-type, and first- and second-order prismatic configurations. Nine possible dislocation line segments are characterised in terms of core geometry, solute binding, glide barriers and faulted-to-perfect transition pathways using QM/ML and newly implemented QM/ML-NEB calculations. Shockley and half-Shockley partials, together with basal and prismatic fault ribbons, are found to govern core stabilisation. Fe and H preferentially bind to faulted segments, whereas Sn and Nb favour perfect segments. Solutes can also drive partial motion, recombination and local unfaulting. These results establish a comprehensive picture of <a> loop microstructure, solute trapping and transition mechanisms in {\alpha}-Zr.

AI.tldr: 该工作用混合量子力学/机器学习框架系统研究了hcp α-Zr中棱柱<a>位错环的芯结构、溶质结合、滑移势垒及由层错向完美结构的转变机制。
AI.motivation: Zr包壳合金在中子辐照下产生缺陷和溶质偏聚，而位错芯同时涉及短程化学与长程弹性场，传统原子尺度方法难以兼顾，因此需要高精度且可扩展的描述手段。
AI.method: 采用QM/ML混合框架，并新实现QM/ML-NEB计算，考察α-Zr中全部三类棱柱<a>环变体，包括层错型与完美型、间隙型与空位型、一阶与二阶棱柱构型，表征九种可能位错线段的核心几何、溶质结合、滑移势垒和层错到完美的转变路径。
AI.result: Shockley与半Shockley分位错以及基面和棱柱面层错带主导位错芯稳定化；Fe和H优先结合层错型线段，而Sn和Nb偏好完美型线段；溶质还可驱动分位错运动、复合和局部去层错化。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了α-Zr中<a>位错环微观结构、溶质捕获和转变机制的较完整图像，为理解辐照条件下Zr合金的位错-溶质相互作用提供了系统依据。

title: Designing Geared Molecular Rotors in Flexible Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: Translating macroscopic mechanical concepts such as gears to the molecular scale offers a route to precise control over nanoscale motion, inspired by the efficiency of biological machines. In this work, we explore two-dimensional interlocked linker rotations in the flexible metal-organic framework NU-2002. The volume-dependent free energy landscape is mapped using bias-deletion metadynamics to identify six characteristic phases, ranging from very closed to very open pore. We then perform unbiased molecular dynamics simulations at each phase to track rotation events and evaluate co-rotation statistics, calculate free energy barriers, and measure pairwise radial force transfer between neighbouring linkers. We show that the free energy barrier acts as a rotational-speed filter, where rare rotational transitions lead to higher speeds on average. Across the volume profile, we classify four distinct geared regimes: sterically restricted rotations at small volumes (Jammed Gear), rotational coupling extending to third neighbour linkers (First Gear), in-plane partnered linker coupling (Second Gear), and uncoupled, independent rotation at large volumes (Neutral Gear). Together, these results establish framework breathing as a molecular gearbox that switches both the speed and collective coupling of linker rotation. Framework flexibility therefore offers a handle for programming collective motion in solid-state molecular machines.

AI.tldr: 在柔性金属有机框架NU-2002中，二维互锁配体旋转随框架“呼吸”呈现四种齿轮状态；体积被证明可作为分子变速箱，同时调控旋转速度与集体耦合。
AI.motivation: 将齿轮等宏观机械概念移植到分子尺度，有望实现对纳米尺度运动的精确控制，并受高效生物机器启发；本文旨在研究柔性MOF中二维互锁配体的旋转行为。
AI.method: 采用偏置删除元动力学映射体积依赖的自由能景观，识别从“很闭孔”到“很开孔”的六个特征相；随后在各相进行无偏分子动力学模拟，追踪旋转事件、评估共旋转统计、计算自由能垒，并测量相邻配体间的成对径向力传递。
AI.result: 自由能垒充当旋转速度过滤器，稀有旋转跃迁平均导致更高速度；随体积变化可分类为四种齿轮机制：小体积下空间受限的Jammed Gear、耦合延伸至第三邻位配体的First Gear、面内配对配体耦合的Second Gear，以及大体积下无耦合独立旋转的Neutral Gear。
AI.conclusion: 框架呼吸构成分子变速箱，可切换配体旋转的速度与集体耦合；因此框架柔性为固态分子机器中的集体运动编程提供了调控手段。

title: Where Does the Anion-Redox Hole Go? Reliability of Open-Shell Projection-Based Embedding for Li-Rich Cathodes, from DFT Environments to Quantum Solvers
summary: Anion redox in Li-rich layered oxides places holes on oxygen next to an antiferromagnetic Mn(IV) d3 lattice, a strongly correlated open-shell problem for which projection-based wavefunction-in-DFT embedding offers a route to correlated and quantum solvers, but whose errors are known mainly for closed-shell molecules. We develop a spin-unrestricted projection-based embedding, exact at the DFT-in-DFT level to the microhartree scale for closed-shell, broken-symmetry and high-spin references with point charges, and apply DMRG-in-DFT to point-charge clusters of delithiated Li(2-x)MnO3, varying the environment functional (0-100% exact exchange), geometry, active region, active-space spin, virtual space, cluster size and magnetic reference. In every setting the lowest SCF state places the hole on an oxygen pair, with no O-O bond. How the hole is shared depends on the functional together with the geometry: hybrids give a full, uncoupled hole at the DFT+U geometry but a partial, weakly covalent hole at their own geometry, a change of up to 0.5 e on one oxygen. Where spin spreads across the active/environment boundary, the integer spin projection of the active space becomes a choice worth up to 0.26 e, and at most 0.09 e once the two Mn neighbors are included. An extended state search found missed lower states for two functionals, changing a pair-oxygen spin by up to 0.45 e. Across all 82 runs the embedded mean field gives the same hole (median DMRG change 0.02-0.04 e); correlation mainly adds O-O covalency. State control and geometry consistency, not the solver, dominate the uncertainty, and total energies are not converged at 30-40 orbitals. For quantum solvers, the embedded Hamiltonian must be spin-unrestricted: a shared-orbital form reverses the hole, while sample-based quantum diagonalization reproduces exact diagonalization, as accurately as, but not better than, classical selected CI.

AI.tldr: 本文建立并系统检验了自旋无限制的投影基波函数-in-DFT嵌入方法，并将其用于DMRG-in-DFT研究脱锂Li(2-x)MnO3点电荷团簇中的氧空穴定位与不确定性来源。
AI.motivation: Li-rich层状氧化物中的阴离子氧化还原会把空穴置于反铁磁Mn(IV) d3晶格旁的氧上，形成强关联开壳层问题；投影基嵌入可连接关联/量子求解器，但此前误差主要在闭壳层分子中被认识。
AI.method: 发展自旋无限制投影基嵌入，在DFT-in-DFT层面对闭壳层、破缺对称和高自旋参考及点电荷达到微hartree精度；对脱锂Li(2-x)MnO3点电荷团簇开展DMRG-in-DFT，扫描环境泛函（0–100%精确交换）、几何、活性区、活性空间自旋、虚空间、团簇尺寸和磁参考。
AI.result: 所有设置下最低SCF态均将空穴放在氧对上且无O–O键；空穴分配强烈依赖泛函与几何，杂化泛函在DFT+U几何给出完整非耦合空穴、在自身几何给出部分弱共价空穴，单氧变化可达0.5 e。跨活性/环境边界的自旋使整数自旋投影成为可达0.26 e的选择，但纳入两个Mn邻居后至多0.09 e。扩展态搜索在两个泛函中发现遗漏的更低态，使对氧自旋变化达0.45 e。82次运行中嵌入平均场给出一致空穴（DMRG中位变化0.02–0.04 e），关联主要增加O–O共价性。态控制与几何一致性而非求解器主导不确定性，30–40轨道下总能量未收敛。对量子求解器，嵌入Hamiltonian必须自旋无限制；共享轨道形式会反转空穴，样本量子对角化可复现精确对角化，但不优于经典selected CI。
AI.conclusion: 氧空穴的可靠预测取决于自旋态控制、几何一致性和嵌入Hamiltonian形式，而非仅提升关联求解器；量子求解器需采用自旋无限制嵌入，且当前总能量与活性空间仍需更严格收敛。

title: Fracture Mechanics and Self-Healing in Molecular Crystal Resonators for Lasing
summary: Microscale damage poses a significant challenge to the reliability and longevity of miniaturized photonic devices; however, the mechanisms and repair of microscopic cracks and fractures in organic optical crystals remain largely unexplored. Here, we employ a mechanophotonic approach to induce microscale cracks and complete fractures in single crystals of 3-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-one (HDMAC) using an atomic force microscopy (AFM) cantilever tip. We demonstrate the self-healing capability of these crystals while retaining their optical waveguiding and resonator properties, which are essential for lasing applications. HDMAC microcrystals exhibit self-healing of cracks introduced along the (010) and (001) crystallographic planes, demonstrating the versatility of this phenomenon across distinct crystal orientations. Furthermore, we identify different fracture mechanisms and establish a comprehensive assessment of healing efficiency by integrating optical loss measurements, resonator characteristics, and nanomechanical analyses. This multifaceted approach enables fair evaluation of the recovery of structural integrity and photonic functionality following self-healing.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用AFM悬臂探针在HDMAC有机光学单晶中引入微尺度裂纹和完全断裂，证明其可自愈合，并保持光波导、谐振腔及激光应用所需功能。
AI.motivation: 微型光子器件中的微尺度损伤会严重影响可靠性和寿命，但有机光学晶体中微裂纹与断裂的机制及修复问题仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 采用机械光子学方法，用AFM悬臂针尖在HDMAC单晶中制造微裂纹和完全断裂；针对沿(010)和(001)晶面的裂纹评估自愈合行为，并结合光损耗测量、谐振腔特性和纳米力学分析建立愈合效率综合评价。
AI.result: HDMAC微晶可自愈合沿不同晶面引入的裂纹，体现该现象在不同晶体取向上的普适性；研究还识别了不同断裂机制，并通过多维度指标评估结构完整性和光子功能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了有机光学晶体在微尺度损伤后的自愈合能力及其在波导、谐振腔和激光应用中的功能保持，为微型光子器件损伤修复与可靠性提升提供了机制认识和评价框架。

title: Spatial localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts in substitutional Mn-doped Ge: A first-principles study
summary: Magnetic energy gaps do not reveal the spatial distribution of magnetic-state-dependent atomic forces. We compare ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic forces at identical nuclear positions in 64-site substitutional Mn-doped Ge using collinear PBE calculations. For nearest-neighbour Mn pairs, the radial force projection reverses sign between magnetic branches. In the second-neighbour geometry, the shared Ge neighbour has the largest force contrast, about 2.2 times that of equally near Ge sites coordinated to one Mn. Bridge-displacement gap slopes agree with direct force derivatives across four numerical settings. Tightening the electronic threshold by 100-fold preserves magnetic ordering and the leading site, while the force-contrast vector changes by 1.08% despite a nearly unchanged energy gap. The results identify coordination-associated localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts within the frozen model, without establishing relaxed distortions, full numerical convergence or a unique exchange mechanism.

AI.tldr: 在64位点Mn掺杂Ge的共线PBE计算中，磁能隙无法揭示磁态相关原子力的空间分布；铁磁与反铁磁分支的力对比主要局域于特定配位环境，尤其第二近邻共享Ge位点，且对更严格的电子阈值较稳健。
AI.motivation: 区分磁有序的能量指标与磁态依赖的局部原子力响应，以理解掺杂磁性半导体中磁分支相关力对比的空间来源，而非仅依赖磁能隙判断。
AI.method: 构建64位点替代式Mn掺杂Ge模型，采用共线PBE，在相同核位置比较铁磁与反铁磁原子力；分析最近邻Mn对与第二近邻几何；用桥位移-能隙斜率与直接力导数对照，并在四种数值设置及电子阈值收紧100倍下检验稳健性。
AI.result: 最近邻Mn对的径向力投影在磁分支间反号；第二近邻几何中共享Ge邻居的力对比最大，约为仅配位一个Mn的等距Ge位点的2.2倍；桥位移能隙斜率与直接力导数一致；电子阈值收紧100倍后磁有序和主导位点保持，力对比矢量仅变化1.08%，而能隙几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 结果在冻结模型内表明磁分支力对比具有配位关联的局域化特征；但未确立弛豫畸变、完整数值收敛性或唯一交换机制。

title: Antisymmetric thermopower without magnetism in three-phase composites
summary: A thermopower that turns a temperature gradient into a perpendicular electric field in every in-plane direction has relied on magnetism. Reciprocity permits it without magnetism, yet under a three-fold or higher axis it vanishes both in reciprocal elastic band transport and in composites of two isotropic phases with ideal interfaces. Here we show that composites of three isotropic phases carry it, and that under such an axis three is the minimum. A third, linearly independent transport matrix escapes the exact two-phase reduction; at weak contrast the first allowed axial term is cubic, proportional to a determinant of the three matrices times material-weighted, handed three-point correlations. Treating the phases as colours identifies the arrangements that allow the response, and crystal nets from reticular chemistry supply printable three-dimensional ones. Certified two-sided bounds give axial Seebeck coefficients of 49.5-50.2 $\mu$V K$^{-1}$ in a planar cell and 76-84 $\mu$V K$^{-1}$ in a printable woodpile; reflections in planes containing the axis reverse the response, and recolouring 24 nets to restore their parent symmetry switches it off. Around a line heat source the axial driving field has the $1/r$ azimuthal form of the magnetic field of a straight wire and drives circulating currents.

AI.tldr: 无磁性条件下，三阶及以上旋转轴中，三各向同性相复合可实现把温度梯度转为面内各方向垂直电场的轴向热电势，且三相是最小数目；文中给出可打印三维网络与μV/K量级系数。
AI.motivation: 此类轴向热电势此前依赖磁性；互易性虽允许无磁实现，但在三阶或更高轴下，互易弹性带输运及两相理想界面复合中的响应均消失，因此需寻找最小材料与结构条件。
AI.method: 将三个各向同性相的输运矩阵纳入分析，弱对比展开；第三线性独立输运矩阵突破两相约化，首个允许轴向项为立方项，正比于三矩阵行列式与材料加权手性三点关联。用相位着色识别允许排列，用网状化学晶体网构造可打印三维结构，并以认证双侧界限计算轴向Seebeck系数，分析对称性与场分布。
AI.result: 三各向同性相复合可承载该响应；平面电池轴向Seebeck系数为49.5-50.2 μV K^{-1}，可打印木垛结构为76-84 μV K^{-1}。含轴平面反射会反转响应；将24种网重着色以恢复母对称则关闭响应。线热源周围轴向驱动场呈1/r方位角形式，类似直导线磁场并驱动循环电流。
AI.conclusion: 无磁轴向热电势可由三各向同性相复合实现，三阶轴下三相为最小数目；该工作给出排列筛选规则、可打印实现、对称性反转/开关机制，并可产生类磁场环流。

title: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
summary: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出电荷密度信息图神经网络CDGNN，从等变原子图中联合学习能量与价电子密度，并在QM9上降低能量预测误差，同时准确预测分子和Fe基体系电荷密度。
AI.motivation: 基态电子密度足以确定基态能量并提供空间电子信息，因此希望将电荷密度相关空间信息引入能量预测，提升图神经网络对能量及电子结构的建模能力。
AI.method: 构建电荷密度信息图神经网络CDGNN，基于等变原子图联合学习能量和价电子密度；将受密度监督的实空间探针表示融入全局能量回归器，使密度相关空间信息参与能量预测。
AI.result: 在QM9数据集上，CDGNN相对等变GNN基线降低了能量预测误差，包括插值和外推到更大分子；在小型含H的Fe和Fe-C数据集上性能与基线相近，显示密度监督收益依赖数据集；CDGNN可准确预测分子及Fe基体系电荷密度分布；注意力分析显示Fe基结构中H原子附近探针表示权重更高。
AI.conclusion: 整合电荷密度信息用于能量预测具有潜力，但其收益具有任务/数据集依赖性，并可同时提升电荷密度分布预测能力。

title: Real-Space Selection Rule for Moir\'e Exciton-Phonon Coupling
summary: Exciton-phonon coupling (ExPC) governs energy relaxation and exciton dynamics in photoexcited quantum materials. Recent advances have revealed rich and tunable excitonic phenomena in moir\'e superlattices, yet the microscopic mechanisms underlying the coupling between moir\'e excitons and moir\'e phonons remain elusive. Here, we develop a real-space representation for moir\'e ExPC based on a unified theoretical framework combining the many-body Bethe-Salpeter equation with phonon perturbation theory. Furthermore, we uncover a general real-space selection rule: the spatial matching of a moir\'e exciton's electron and hole densities with the moir\'e-phonon-induced potential perturbations determines their individual coupling contributions, while coherent interference between the electron and hole contributions controls the total ExPC. We demonstrate this rule in prototypical WSe2/WS2 moir\'e heterobilayers, revealing pronounced exciton- and phonon-mode-dependent coupling, including nearly complete suppression of ExPC through destructive electron-hole interference. These findings establish the internal electron-hole spatial configuration of moir\'e excitons as a key degree of freedom governing the strength and mode selectivity of their coupling to moir\'e phonons, opening opportunities to engineer ExPC through spatially tailored moir\'e potentials.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了基于多体Bethe-Salpeter方程与声子微扰理论的实空间理论框架，揭示莫尔激子-声子耦合由电子/空穴密度与莫尔声子势微扰的空间匹配及电子-空穴相干干涉共同决定，并在WSe2/WS2中展示了强烈的激子和声子模式选择性。
AI.motivation: 莫尔超晶格中激子-声子耦合控制能量弛豫和激子动力学，但莫尔激子与莫尔声子耦合的微观机制尚不清楚，尤其是激子内部电子-空穴空间构型如何影响耦合强度与模式选择性。
AI.method: 发展莫尔激子-声子耦合的实空间表示，将多体Bethe-Salpeter方程与声子微扰理论统一结合；提出实空间选择定则，分析莫尔激子电子和空穴密度与莫尔声子诱导势微扰的空间匹配，并考虑电子与空穴贡献的相干干涉；在原型WSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层中进行验证。
AI.result: 发现耦合强烈依赖于激子态和声子模式；单个电子或空穴贡献由相应密度与声子势微扰的空间匹配决定，而总耦合受电子-空穴干涉控制；在WSe2/WS2中可实现近完全抑制的激子-声子耦合，源于电子-空穴贡献的相消干涉。
AI.conclusion: 莫尔激子的内部电子-空穴空间构型是调控其与莫尔声子耦合强度和模式选择性的关键自由度；通过空间剪裁莫尔势可工程化激子-声子耦合。

title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
summary: Transition-metal-based batteries rely on critical elements such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel. Their extraction creates environmental and supply-chain challenges. Organic electrode materials (OEMs) reduce this reliance and provide broad molecular tunability. However, OEM-based batteries still show limited long-term cycling stability. Their design also requires the joint optimization of coupled metrics such as voltage, specific capacity, capacity retention, and energy density. These metrics depend on the full battery stack and on the interactions among its components rather than on the active material alone. In our previous work, we developed a data-fusion multi-task framework for average discharge voltage and first-cycle specific capacity. Both targets are single-valued. Here, we extend that framework to multi-horizon prediction by predicting a property at every cycle of a discharge trajectory rather than at a single cycle. Our multi-fidelity and Multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories within one model. We train it on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions, so it learns battery-stack interactions rather than cathode-only effects. This framework supports long-term property prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic battery systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作将原用于单值指标预测的数据融合多任务框架扩展为多步预测，构建多保真度、多步深度算子网络，在同模型中学习DFT氧化还原电位与循环依赖的比容量轨迹，并基于完整电池堆栈表示和使用条件预测有机电池长期性能。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属电池依赖锂、钴、镍等关键元素，带来环境与供应链问题；有机电极材料可降低依赖并具分子可调性，但长期循环稳定性有限。其设计需联合优化电压、比容量、容量保持率和能量密度等耦合指标，且这些指标取决于完整电池堆栈及组分相互作用，而非仅正极材料。
AI.method: 在前期面向平均放电电压和首圈比容量的数据融合多任务框架基础上，扩展至多步预测：不再只预测单一循环，而是预测放电轨迹中每个循环的性质。提出多保真度、多步深度算子网络，在单一模型中学习DFT氧化还原电位和循环依赖的比容量轨迹，并以完整电池堆栈表示及使用条件为输入训练。
AI.result: 框架实现了从单值指标到多步轨迹的预测扩展，可在同一模型中同时建模DFT氧化还原电位与循环比容量演化，并学习电池堆栈层面的相互作用而非仅正极效应。摘要未给出定量性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架面向有机电池系统支持长期性质预测、反向设计和工艺优化，为降低关键金属依赖并联合优化耦合性能指标提供数据驱动方法。

title: ZnO/Ni interface-activated enhancement of spintronic terahertz emission from Ni/Pt bilayers
summary: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal bilayers provide an efficient route for generating broadband THz radiation through ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. However, Ni/Pt bilayers usually exhibit relatively weak THz emission, limiting their use as efficient spintronic emitters. Here, we report an interface-assisted enhancement of THz emission in ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures. By placing ZnO underneath Ni while preserving the direct Ni/Pt contact, the THz amplitude is increased by up to approximately 2.8 times compared with the Ni/Pt reference. The enhanced emission reverses polarity with the magnetic field and follows the expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. ZnO-, Ni-, and Pt-thickness-dependent measurements show that the emission remains governed by the Ni/Pt conversion process but is strongly affected by the ZnO/Ni bottom interface. Control samples with Al2O3, Cu, and Fe further exclude a simple underlayer, optical, or growth-quality origin. The enhancement is attributed to a short-range ZnO/Ni interface effect, possibly involving oxygen-related defects, interfacial electric fields, and modification of the Ni interfacial state. This work provides a semiconductor/ferromagnet interface-engineering strategy for activating weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters.

AI.tldr: 通过在Ni/Pt双层下方引入ZnO层并保持Ni/Pt直接接触，ZnO/Ni/Pt异质结将Ni/Pt自旋电子太赫兹发射幅度最高提升约2.8倍，且增强源于ZnO/Ni短程界面效应。
AI.motivation: Ni/Pt双层虽可通过超快自旋-电荷转换产生宽带太赫兹辐射，但其发射较弱，限制其作为高效自旋电子太赫兹发射器的应用；作者希望在不破坏Ni/Pt转换界面的前提下提升发射效率。
AI.method: 构建ZnO/Ni/Pt异质结构，将ZnO置于Ni下方并保留直接Ni/Pt接触；测量太赫兹发射随磁场极性和角度依赖，并进行ZnO、Ni、Pt厚度依赖实验；利用Al2O3、Cu、Fe对照样品排除简单衬底、光学效应或生长质量因素。
AI.result: ZnO/Ni/Pt的太赫兹幅度较Ni/Pt参考样品最高增强约2.8倍；发射极性随磁场反转，角度依赖符合超快自旋-电荷转换；厚度依赖表明发射仍由Ni/Pt转换过程主导，但受ZnO/Ni底界面强烈影响；对照样品支持增强来自短程ZnO/Ni界面效应，可能涉及氧相关缺陷、界面电场及Ni界面态修饰。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种半导体/铁磁体界面工程策略，可激活弱Ni/Pt自旋电子太赫兹发射器，并为提升自旋电子太赫兹源效率提供界面调控途径。

title: The role of A in ARPES
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) was developed in the 1970s-1990s as a momentum-resolved probe of the electronic structure of solids, with its basic principles summarized in early seminal works and classic reviews. The basic ARPES result is currently almost exclusively associated with the two-dimensional intensity distribution with coordinate axes labeled as Binding Energy and Momentum. Such datasets are usually directly compared to the band structure calculations along high symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Here we show that this is the result of an oversimplified treatment of the ARPES data leading to incorrect interpretations of the experimental results. We suggest practical ways of how to avoid it in both data collection and analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，将ARPES数据简化为“结合能-动量”二维强度图并直接与布里渊区高对称方向能带计算比较，是一种过度简化的处理，可能导致对实验结果的错误解释，并提出数据采集与分析中的实用改进建议。
AI.motivation: ARPES是动量分辨的固体电子结构探针，但当前常规分析几乎只依赖二维强度分布并与高对称方向能带计算直接比较，可能掩盖数据解读中的问题。
AI.method: 作者评述并指出常规ARPES数据处理中的过度简化问题，并据此提出在数据采集和数据分析中避免误读的实用方法。
AI.result: 研究表明，这种简化的ARPES数据处理会导致对实验结果的错误解释。
AI.conclusion: ARPES数据不应被简单化为二维强度图并与高对称方向能带计算直接对应；需要在采集和分析环节采用更严谨的流程以避免误读。

title: Spontaneous topological diode effect induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order
summary: In non-centrosymmetric bulk materials, electrons flowing in the opposite directions often exhibit different properties. This diode-like effect (i.e., non-reciprocal electron transport) typically originates from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, and its amplitude scales with external magnetic field or magnetization in ferromagnets. Although such rectification is usually absent in antiferromagnets at zero field, recent theories predict that non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order can host large non-reciprocity even without spin-orbit coupling, magnetization or external magnetic fields. This phenomenon - the spontaneous topological diode effect - can potentially be used for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, while it has not been verified for real materials. Here, we report the observation of this effect in a chiral-lattice non-coplanar antiferromagnet CoTa3S6. Nonlinear resistivity measurements reveal the non reciprocal nature of electron transport along the [001] direction at zero field. The observed non-reciprocity exceeds that in typical ferromagnets, whose amplitude is governed by antiferromagnetic order parameter rather than magnetization. First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response. The present findings demonstrate a new mechanism for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, and highlight non-coplanar antiferromagnets as a promising material platform for realizing ferromagnet-like functional responses without relying on spin-orbit coupling or magnetization.

AI.tldr: 在 chiral-lattice 非共面反铁磁体 CoTa3S6 中首次实验观察到零场自发拓扑二极管效应：沿 [001] 方向的非线性电阻表现出非互易输运，且源于非共面反铁磁序诱导的非相对论性能带不对称。
AI.motivation: 非互易电子输运通常依赖自旋轨道耦合以及外磁场或磁化，反铁磁体在零场下一般缺乏此类整流效应；理论预测非共面反铁磁序可在无自旋轨道耦合、无磁化、无外场时产生大的自发拓扑二极管效应，但尚缺乏真实材料验证。
AI.method: 对 chiral-lattice 非共面反铁磁体 CoTa3S6 进行零场下沿 [001] 方向的非线性电阻测量，以表征电子输运的非互易性；并结合第一性原理计算分析非共面反铁磁序对能带色散的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现 CoTa3S6 在零场沿 [001] 方向存在非互易电子输运，其非互易幅度超过典型铁磁体，并由反铁磁序参量而非磁化控制；第一性原理计算表明非共面反铁磁序在无自旋轨道耦合时即可诱导不对称能带色散，证实观测响应的非相对论起源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实验验证了 spontaneous topological diode effect，确立了非共面反铁磁体中不依赖自旋轨道耦合或磁化的新机制，为反铁磁畴的高效电学读出提供途径，并表明非共面反铁磁体是实现类铁磁功能响应的有前景材料平台。

title: Prussian blue and Prussian white thin-film electrodes: Single-step electrodeposition for anode and cathode applications
summary: This study examines how deposition potential influences the composition and nanoscale structure of Prussian Blue (PB)/Prussian White (PW)-family films, providing an experimental basis for assessing their proposed functions. Films were grown directly on Au/Cr/Si in a single potentiostatic step from a common aqueous bath at $-0.20$ to $+0.40$\,V versus a saturated calomel electrode, with a fixed deposition charge of 10\,mC. Electron microscopy, elemental analysis, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and Raman spectroscopy revealed potential-dependent chemistry and nonmonotonic morphology. EDS indicated greater K incorporation in lower-potential deposits, whose Fe~2p and Raman features were consistent with more reduced, PW-like environments. Surface K/Fe ratios varied nonmonotonically from 1.129 to 1.322 across the series, corresponding to 52.95--56.94\% K within the detected K+Fe population. Larger faceted crystallites at $+0.30$\,V contrasted with finer pyramids and cracks at $+0.40$\,V. Selected PB-like and PW-like regions had local cubic lattice parameters of $(10.31\pm0.10)$\,\AA\ and $(10.36\pm0.10)$\,\AA, respectively; their overlapping uncertainties prevent discrimination by lattice spacing alone. Cross-sectional maps showed broadly uniform framework-element distributions within locally continuous coatings. Together, these observations relate deposition conditions to contrasting chemical and morphological starting states without establishing bulk stoichiometry or phase purity. A literature-grounded outlook identifies ion storage, sensing, electrochromism, resistive switching, and ion handling as research opportunities requiring functional validation in these films.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察沉积电位对PB/PW族薄膜组成与纳米结构的影响，并据此讨论其潜在功能。
AI.motivation: 为评估PB/PW族薄膜的拟议功能，需要建立沉积条件与其化学状态、形貌和纳米结构之间的实验关联。
AI.method: 在Au/Cr/Si基底上，从同一水溶液体系以单步恒电位法在-0.20至+0.40 V（vs. SCE）沉积，固定沉积电荷10 mC；采用电子显微镜、元素分析、XPS和Raman光谱表征。
AI.result: 低电位沉积物中K掺入更多，Fe 2p和Raman特征更接近还原态PW；表面K/Fe比非单调变化于1.129–1.322，对应检测到的K+Fe群体中K占52.95–56.94%。+0.30 V形成较大刻面晶粒，+0.40 V则出现更细金字塔形结构及裂纹。PB样和PW样区域局域立方晶格参数分别为(10.31±0.10) Å和(10.36±0.10) Å，误差重叠，不能仅凭晶格间距区分。截面映射显示局部连续涂层内骨架元素分布总体均匀。
AI.conclusion: 沉积条件与不同的化学和形貌起始状态相关，但未建立体相化学计量或相纯度；离子存储、传感、电致变色、阻变和离子处理被指出为需进一步功能验证的研究方向。

title: First-Principles Investigation of Irida-Graphane: A Wide-Band-Gap Semiconductor Derived from Irida-Graphene
summary: Opening a band gap in metallic two-dimensional carbon allotropes is an important step toward their use in electronic and optoelectronic devices, and full hydrogenation has proven to be an effective route to achieve it. Here, we propose irida-graphane, the fully hydrogenated derivative of the irida-graphene, a monolayer composed of three-, six-, and eight-membered rings, and investigate its structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory (DFT) at the PBE and HSE06 levels combined with phonon and \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. All carbon atoms adopt $sp^3$ hybridization, with the hydrogen atoms of the three- and six-membered rings bonded to opposite sides of a buckled carbon framework, and the lattice parameter contracts by 4.3% with respect to irida-graphene. The hydrogenation energy of $-0.53$ eV/H indicates that the hydrogenation of irida-graphene from molecular hydrogen is exothermic. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies confirms the dynamical stability of irida-graphane, and AIMD simulations show that its structure remains intact at temperatures up to 2000 K. Irida-graphane is mechanically isotropic, with an in-plane stiffness of approximately 156 N/m, a Poisson's ratio of approximately 0.1, and critical strains of approximately 20%. Hydrogenation transforms the metallic parent structure into a semiconductor with an indirect band gap of 4.68 eV (PBE) and 6.0 eV (HSE06). Irida-graphane is transparent in the visible range, with reflectivity below 0.3%, and absorbs strongly in the deep ultraviolet, with absorption coefficients of the order of $10^{5} - 10^{6}$ cm$^{-1}$. These results suggest irida-graphane as a candidate wide-gap material for ultraviolet optoelectronics and transparent coatings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统研究了石墨烯类似物 irida-graphene 的全氢化衍生物 irida-graphane；DFT 计算表明其结构稳定、机械各向同性，并由金属性转变为宽带隙半导体，适用于紫外光电子学和透明涂层。
AI.motivation: 金属性二维碳同素异形体缺乏带隙，限制其在电子和光电器件中的应用；全氢化已被证明是打开带隙的有效途径，因此作者研究由三、六、八元环组成的 irida-graphene 的全氢化衍生物 irida-graphane。
AI.method: 采用 PBE 和 HSE06 水平的密度泛函理论计算结构、力学、电子和光学性质，并结合声子谱与从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟评估稳定性和热稳定性。
AI.result: 所有碳原子为 sp3 杂化，三元和六元环上的氢原子位于起伏碳骨架两侧，晶格常数相对 irida-graphene 收缩 4.3%；氢化能为 -0.53 eV/H，表明由分子氢氢化为放热过程。无虚频声子证明动力学稳定，AIMD 显示至 2000 K 结构保持完整。材料机械各向同性，面内刚度约 156 N/m，泊松比约 0.1，临界应变约 20%。氢化使金属性母体变为间接带隙半导体，PBE 带隙 4.68 eV，HSE06 带隙 6.0 eV。可见光区透明，反射率低于 0.3%，深紫外区强吸收，吸收系数约 10^5–10^6 cm^-1。
AI.conclusion: irida-graphane 是一种稳定的宽禁带二维材料候选，可用于紫外光电子学和透明涂层。

title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
summary: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.

AI.tldr: GMMag 是一种生成晶体结构及其位点分辨磁矩的工作流，基于图神经网络编码器与 Transformer 解码器的条件变分自编码器，并通过高斯混合采样实现无需重训练的目标导向生成。
AI.motivation: 旨在同时生成晶体结构与位点分辨磁矩，并可控地面向指定化学与磁性目标进行筛选，用于发现参考数据集中未出现的新候选材料。
AI.method: 构建条件 VAE：GNN 编码器、Transformer 解码器；采用高斯混合采样重定向生成而不重训练；系统研究编码器/解码器设计、磁矩幅值与相对符号表示及采样策略对重构、生成质量和多样性的影响；并建模重复生成同一化学式对候选积累的限制，在两个独立的千万次抽样实验中测试。
AI.result: 发现更高筛选通过率不一定带来更多具有参考数据集中未出现化学式的合格候选；通过重复生成建模评估了化学式积累限制；应用中找到含 Nd、化学式未见于参考数据集、形成能为负且估计饱和磁化强度高的候选。
AI.conclusion: GMMag 可实现晶体结构与磁矩的联合目标导向生成，但候选发现需同时考虑筛选通过率与化学式多样性/重复生成限制；其在 Nd 基磁性候选筛选中展示了应用潜力。

title: Enhancing magneto-optical coupling and scattering from magnetic vortices by optical polarization texturing
summary: Magnetic textures offer a route toward photonic functionality in which electromagnetic fields are controlled not only by material composition and geometry but also by the internal magnetic configuration. Conversely, spatial texturing of these fields is a qualitatively new tool to increase the effective coupling strength to magnetic matter and to act on the the vortex topology and magnetic dynamics. Here, we investigate the coupling and scattering of structured electromagnetic fields by a magnetic vortex, focusing on how spatially non-collinear magnetization governs polarization conversion, electromagnetic energy flow, and magnetization dynamics. We develop a spherical rigorous coupled-wave method that incorporates the spatially dependent anisotropic magnetic permeability associated with the vortex texture. The calculations show that the off-diagonal components of the magnetic susceptibility mediate conversion into complementary polarization channels that are absent from the incident field. The generated fields exhibit pronounced spatial localization associated with the vortex magnetization profile and support a nonzero azimuthal component of electromagnetic energy flow. A comparison between linearly and radially polarized illumination reveals an approximately one-order-of-magnitude difference in the scattered fields amplitudes due to polarization texturing, demonstrating the importance of spatial overlap between the incident field and the anisotropic magnetic response. The back-action on the magnetic vortex dynamics is quantitatively demonstrated by numerical simulations for the inverse Faraday effect due to the rectification of structured effective-field excitation. It is shown that polarization textured optical fields can drive vortex-core precession and, at sufficiently strong excitation, reverse the core polarity and chirality on nanosecond time scale.

AI.tldr: 该文研究结构电磁场与磁涡旋的耦合，揭示非共线磁化如何主导偏振转换、能流与磁化动力学。
AI.motivation: 磁织构为光子功能提供新途径，使电磁场不仅由材料与几何控制，也受内部磁构型调控；反之，空间结构化光场可作为增强与磁性物质有效耦合、作用于涡旋拓扑与磁动力学的新工具。
AI.method: 建立包含磁涡旋空间依赖各向异性磁导率的球面严格耦合波方法，计算结构电磁场被磁涡旋散射与耦合的过程，比较线偏振与径向偏振照明，并用数值模拟反法拉第效应评估对涡旋动力学的反作用。
AI.result: 磁化率的非对角分量导致向入射场中不存在的互补偏振通道转换；生成场随涡旋磁化分布显著空间局域，并具有非零方位角能流分量；线偏振与径向偏振照明的散射场振幅相差约一个数量级，显示入射场与各向异性磁响应空间重叠的重要性；结构化有效场激发可驱动涡旋核进动，并在足够强激发下于纳秒时间尺度反转核极性与手性。
AI.conclusion: 空间结构化光场与磁涡旋各向异性磁响应的空间重叠决定耦合与散射特性，并可定量控制涡旋核动力学乃至拓扑反转，为磁织构光子学与全光磁拓扑操控提供依据。

title: Unconventional SOC-activated Altermagnetic Spin Splitting and Half-Angle Locking of Spin Transport
summary: Conventional altermagnetic spin splitting arises from staggered exchange and sublattice-dependent anisotropic hopping without requiring spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here we derive a low-energy effective model showing that SOC and staggered exchange can jointly activate additional spin splitting on momentum planes where the nonrelativistic contribution vanishes. In hexagonal $\alpha$-MnTe, this SOC-activated contribution produces d-wave spin splitting near $\Gamma$ with out-of-plane spin polarization. Its leading angular pattern counter-rotates by half the in-plane N\'eel-vector rotation angle. First-principles spin-transport calculations reveal a corresponding approximate half-angle locking between the N\'eel-vector orientation and the electric-field directions maximizing the signed longitudinal and transverse spin conductivities. Analytical transport calculations based on the effective model trace this locking to the same angular coupling between momentum and the N\'eel vector that governs the spin-splitting pattern. Our findings connect the microscopic mechanism of SOC-activated altermagnetic spin splitting to directional spin transport, providing a theoretical basis for probing N\'eel-vector orientation and controlling spin-current generation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证了SOC与交错交换共同激活的交替磁自旋分裂机制，并将其与α-MnTe中可观测的各向异性自旋输运及Néel矢量取向锁定联系起来。
AI.motivation: 传统交替磁自旋分裂无需SOC，由交错交换和子晶格相关各向异性跃迁产生；作者关注在非相对论贡献消失的动量面上，SOC与交错交换能否共同诱导额外自旋分裂，并探索其输运效应。
AI.method: 构建低能有效模型分析SOC激活的自旋分裂；以六角α-MnTe为例结合第一性原理自旋输运计算，并用基于有效模型的解析输运计算追踪角向锁定机制。
AI.result: 在α-MnTe中，SOC激活贡献在Γ点附近形成d波自旋分裂且自旋极化为面外；其主导角向图样随面内Néel矢量旋转反向旋转半角。第一性原理计算显示Néel矢量取向与最大化有符号纵向/横向自旋电导的电场方向呈近似半角锁定，解析计算表明该锁定源于动量与Néel矢量间同一角向耦合。
AI.conclusion: 研究将SOC激活交替磁自旋分裂的微观机制与方向性自旋输运相联系，为探测Néel矢量取向和控制自旋流产生提供理论基础。

title: Back-End-Of-Line Integration of 2-Terminal Ferroelectric Hafnia Synaptic Weights on Commercial CMOS Process
summary: Functionalising the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS with emerging materials is a key route to neural network accelerators and neuromorphic systems. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time the integration of 2-terminal ferroelectric synaptic weights in the BEOL of as-delivered commercial 180 nm CMOS dies. A novel material stack is proposed, in which a WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2] bilayer is sandwiched between TiN and Mo electrodes. For devices annealed at 450 {\deg}C, programming below 1.8 V is achieved with a cycle-to-cycle variation below 3 %. Synaptic weights annealed at 500 {\deg}C exhibit more gradual weight updates, while the tested underlying NMOS transistors remain functional after the complete integration process. The trade-off between thermal budget and on-device training performance is illustrated using hardware-aware neural network simulations.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次在商用180 nm CMOS后段工艺中集成两端铁电突触权重，并基于WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层材料堆叠实现低电压编程与可调权重更新。
AI.motivation: 将新兴材料功能化到CMOS后段工艺（BEOL）是构建神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键路径，目标是在不破坏底层CMOS的前提下实现突触器件集成。
AI.method: 在商用180 nm CMOS裸片上，采用TiN/Mo电极夹持WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层的新型材料堆叠，制备两端铁电突触权重；分别考察450°C和500°C退火条件，并结合硬件感知神经网络仿真评估热预算与片上训练性能的权衡。
AI.result: 450°C退火器件可在低于1.8 V下编程，循环间变异低于3%；500°C退火突触权重表现出更渐进的权重更新；完整集成流程后，测试的底层NMOS晶体管仍保持功能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在商用CMOS BEOL中集成铁电突触权重的可行性，并揭示了退火热预算与器件编程特性及片上训练性能之间的关键权衡。

title: The Acridine Polymorph Landscape: Characterization and Selective Control by Additives
summary: Polymorphism in molecular crystals presents a major challenge for controlling crystallization. Here, we combine experiment and theory to characterize the polymorph landscape of acridine and investigate its selective control by additives. Melt crystallization experiments resolve the previously unknown structure of form VIII, while topological crystal structure prediction recovers all seven known unsolvated polymorphs with determined crystal structures. Combining a fine-tuned machine-learned interatomic potential with anharmonic free energy calculations reproduces the experimentally observed stability relationships and reveals a shallow free energy landscape. Finally, experimentally observed additive-induced polymorph preferences correlate with mixed-crystal substitutional defect energies and topological similarities between additive and acridine crystal structures. Together, these results provide a comprehensive picture of acridine polymorphism, linking crystal structure, thermodynamic stability, and additive-controlled crystallization.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合实验与理论解析吖啶的多晶型景观，并揭示添加剂选择性控制结晶的机制。
AI.motivation: 分子晶体多晶型难以控制，需要理解晶型景观、热力学稳定性及添加剂诱导选择性的微观基础。
AI.method: 通过熔融结晶解析新晶型VIII；用拓扑晶体结构预测恢复7种已知无溶剂多晶型；结合精细调校的机器学习原子间势与非谐自由能计算；并将添加剂诱导的多晶型偏好与混合晶体取代缺陷能及添加剂-吖啶晶体结构拓扑相似性关联。
AI.result: 计算重现实验观察到的稳定性关系并揭示浅自由能景观；添加剂诱导的多晶型偏好与混合晶体取代缺陷能和拓扑相似性相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供吖啶多晶型的综合图景，将晶体结构、热力学稳定性与添加剂控制结晶联系起来。

title: Coulomb- and exchange-driven redistribution of spectral correlations
summary: Electronic correlations reorganize not only the energies of individual electronic states but also the collective structure of the spectrum. Here, first-principles density functional theory calculations combined with random-matrix spectral statistics are used to examine this reorganization in gamma-Ce within a static spin-polarized DFT+U+SOC description. We distinguish the effects of the Coulomb interaction U from those of the exchange interaction J by analyzing nearest-neighbor spacings, reduced spacing ratios, band velocities, and band curvatures across the Ce-4f manifold. Increasing U does not produce a monotonic transition between Poisson- and Wigner-Dyson-like statistics; instead, the region of strongest level repulsion migrates across the 4f manifold as the interaction increases. Exchange produces a qualitatively different response. At fixed U, strongly repulsive and strongly clustered spectral regions coexist within the same 4f manifold even while the total spin moment and 4f occupation remain nearly unchanged. The clustering persists after resolving the spectrum into its dominant j = 5/2 and j = 7/2 components and differs strongly between calculations having the same numerical value of U-J. Within the present DFT+U+SOC description, the spectral response therefore depends on the separate Coulomb and exchange interactions and cannot be represented completely by a single effective U-J parameter. These results show that energy- and character-resolved spectral statistics expose correlation-driven electronic reorganization that is hidden by conventional integrated observables.

AI.tldr: 该文用DFT+U+SOC结合随机矩阵谱统计研究γ-Ce中Ce-4f电子关联对能谱集体结构的重组，表明Coulomb相互作用U与交换相互作用J效应不同，不能仅用单一有效U-J参数描述。
AI.motivation: 电子关联不仅改变单个电子态能量，也改变谱的集体结构；常规积分观测量可能掩盖这种关联驱动的电子重组，因此需要能量分辨和轨道/特征分辨的谱统计。
AI.method: 采用静态自旋极化第一性原理DFT+U+SOC计算γ-Ce，在Ce-4f流形内分析最近邻能级间距、约化间距比、带速度和带曲率，并区分U与J的贡献，同时分辨主要的j=5/2和j=7/2分量。
AI.result: 增大U并不导致Poisson型到Wigner-Dyson型统计的单调转变，最强能级排斥区域随U在4f流形中迁移；固定U时，同一4f流形内可共存强排斥和强聚集区域，而总自旋矩与4f占据几乎不变。聚集在分辨j=5/2和j=7/2后仍存在，且在相同数值U-J的不同计算间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 在该DFT+U+SOC描述中，谱响应分别依赖Coulomb相互作用U和交换相互作用J，不能由单一有效U-J参数完全表示；能量和特征分辨的谱统计可揭示常规积分观测量所隐藏的关联驱动电子重组。

title: Rotational Perturbation Theory for Magnetic Interactions
summary: We develop rotational perturbation theory for magnetic interactions in collinear and noncollinear systems, distinguishing prescribed rotations of exchange fields from constrained rotations of magnetic moments. At the full exchange splitting, we derive Green-function expressions for prescribedfield energy curvatures directly from perturbation theory, without invoking the local force theorem; constrained-moment curvatures additionally require the stationary magnetic response and are related to the inverse static susceptibility. We examine noncollinear pair interactions and planar and conical spin spirals, and derive the long-wavelength ferromagnetic spin-wave stiffness and, assuming adiabatic sublattice precession, the antiferromagnetic spin-wave velocity. Orbital-nonlocal magnetic potentials and correlated electronic response reveal further requirements for connecting rotational curvatures to collective magnetic behavior. As a practical extension, we project the complete transverse pair Hessian onto an effective scalar Heisenberg exchange and quantify the unreconstructed curvature. Biquadratic and three-spin examples illustrate why locally extracted exchange coefficients need not represent transferable bilinear interactions.

AI.tldr: 该文建立磁相互作用的旋转微扰理论，区分交换场的规定旋转与磁矩的约束旋转，并据此推导磁刚度、自旋波刚度和速度，指出局域提取的交换系数未必是可迁移的双线性相互作用。
AI.motivation: 需要统一处理共线与非共线磁体系中的旋转磁响应，厘清规定场旋转与约束磁矩旋转的差异，并将旋转曲率与集体磁行为及可迁移的Heisenberg交换参数可靠关联。
AI.method: 发展旋转微扰理论，在全交换劈裂下直接用Green函数给出规定场能量曲率而无需局域力定理；约束磁矩曲率还需平稳磁响应并关联逆静态磁化率。分析非共线对相互作用、平面与锥形自旋螺旋，推导长波铁磁自旋波刚度和绝热子晶格进动下的反铁磁自旋波速度；将完整横向对Hessian投影到有效标量Heisenberg交换并量化未重构曲率，用双二次和三自旋例子说明。
AI.result: 得到规定场与约束磁矩旋转曲率的Green函数表达式及二者关系；给出铁磁自旋波刚度和反铁磁自旋波速度；表明轨道非局域磁势与关联电子响应会带来额外条件；Hessian投影可量化未重构曲率，双二次与三自旋例子显示局域提取交换系数不必然对应可迁移的双线性相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 旋转曲率到集体磁行为的映射依赖于旋转约束、平稳磁响应及非局域/关联电子效应；局域提取的交换系数不应默认可迁移为双线性Heisenberg交换，需用完整横向Hessian及非双线性项审慎解释。

title: An exactly solvable obstructed seam on a lattice Klein bottle: bulk-locked Majorana rings and register-dependent toric codes
summary: We study a frustrated seam produced by literal reflection gluing of Wen's plaquette model on a closed lattice Klein bottle. The seam operators anticommute along two cycles for even circumference and one cycle of twice the length for odd circumference. Their algebra reduces to free Majorana rings, while the commuting bulk stabilizers constrain the allowed ring sectors. This bulk locking yields exact ground energies, excitation gaps and degeneracies, checked by phase-aware Pauli traces and finite-size diagonalization, including two 24-qubit energy predictions. The seam degeneracy is not topological: the single-site seam fields tested split it at second order. We contrast this obstructed gluing with consistent toric-code realizations. An edge register preserves the anyon labels; a Hadamard-dressed site register has colour-dependent seam transport, with ground-state degeneracy 2 or 4 for even circumference and a sign-frustrated exception at odd circumference. For the enumerated lattice isometries and sizes, we compute logical gates and distances, distinguishing abstract qubit relabelling from local hardware depth. Finally, on three 16- and 24-qubit lattices, chiral matter selects a holonomy doublet whose electric-field splitting follows two competing tunnelling routes. These matter results remain finite-size statements. The main result is the exact obstructed-seam solution with bulk sector locking; the register, gate and matter calculations delimit its relation to topological codes.

AI.tldr: 本文在闭 Klein 瓶上通过字面反射胶合 Wen 方片模型构造受挫缝合线，给出精确的“受阻缝合”解：缝合算符代数化为自由 Majorana 环，并由体内稳定子锁定允许的环扇区；同时界定其与拓扑码、逻辑门及手征物质的关系。
AI.motivation: 研究在 Wen 方片模型中引入反射胶合产生的受挫缝合线，区分其退化是否具有拓扑性，并厘清这种受阻胶合与可实现拓扑码（如 toric code）及逻辑寄存器和物质激发之间的关系。
AI.method: 在闭 Klein 瓶上对 Wen 方片模型做字面反射胶合；分析缝合算符沿周期的反对易代数，将其约化为自由 Majorana 环，并利用交换的体内稳定子约束环扇区。通过相位敏感的 Pauli 迹和有限尺寸对角化验证精确基态能量、激发 gap 与退化度，包括两个 24-qubit 能量预测；进一步对比 toric-code 实现，构造 edge register 与 Hadamard-dressed site register，枚举格点等距与尺寸计算逻辑门和距离，并在 16/24-qubit 格点上分析手征物质的 holonomy 双重态与电场劈裂。
AI.result: 偶数周长时缝合算符沿两个 cycle 反对易，奇数周长时沿一个长度加倍的 cycle 反对易；其代数化为自由 Majorana 环，体内稳定子导致 bulk sector locking，从而得到精确基态能量、激发 gap 和退化度。缝合退化并非拓扑：测试的单格点缝合场在二阶劈裂它。与一致的 toric-code 实现对比，edge register 保持 anyon 标签；Hadamard-dressed site register 具有颜色依赖的缝合输运，偶数周长基态退化度为 2 或 4，奇数周长存在符号受挫例外。对枚举的格点等距和尺寸计算逻辑门与距离，并区分抽象 qubit 重标号与局域硬件深度。三个 16- 和 24-qubit 格点上，手征物质选择 holonomy 双重态，其电场劈裂遵循两条竞争隧道路径；这些物质结果仍为有限尺寸结论。
AI.conclusion: 核心结果是带 bulk sector locking 的精确受阻缝合解；寄存器、逻辑门和物质计算限定了该构造与拓扑码的关系，并表明缝合退化本身不具拓扑性。

title: Agentic Swarms Discover Enhanchment of Fractional Chern Insulator Gaps Beyond Ideal Quantum Geometry
summary: Can artificial intelligence (AI) move beyond solving well-defined problems to contribute to open-ended discovery in fundamental physics? Could AI propose what to explore, identify unexpected phenomena, and uncover their mechanisms? We address this using MOSAIC (Multi-agent Open-ended Scientific Analysis and Investigation through Collaboration), a collaborative swarm of AI agents (Claude Opus 5.5), to tackle a longstanding bottleneck: the small energy gaps limiting the robustness of fractional topological order and the study of anyons at higher temperatures. Rather than prescribing a model, we ask frontier models (GPT-6 Astra) to propose a theoretical framework, which MOSAIC explores through diverse strategies and rapid exchange of ideas. This reveals a striking finding: although ideal quantum geometry is considered favorable for fractional states, departing from this limit can dramatically enhance their robustness, with many-body gaps more than an order of magnitude larger than in the ideal case. Without centralized coordination, the agents explored autonomously, combined findings across agents, and formed insights from individual runs, outperforming isolated agents with the same tools. AI-assisted theoretical analysis further develops simplified models with an analytical gap enhancement factor that is unbounded within the single-band approximation. Remarkably, AI identifies the real-space quantum metric, rather than the momentum-space one, as the key quantity governing the many-body gap, revealing how flat-band wavefunctions shape two-electron interactions and yielding an index computable from single-particle wavefunctions without many-body ED to guide gap optimization. Our study demonstrates how collaborative AI agents can integrate exploration, discovery of unexpected physics, and theoretical understanding, opening new possibilities for AI-driven research in fundamental physics.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC 多智能体协作系统让前沿 AI 模型提出理论框架并自主探索，发现偏离理想量子几何可显著增强分数量子拓扑序的能隙，并揭示实空间量子度量是调控多体能隙的关键。
AI.motivation: 解决分数量子拓扑序与任意子研究中的长期瓶颈：能隙过小导致拓扑序鲁棒性不足，限制更高温度下的任意子研究；并检验 AI 能否从解题走向基础物理中的开放式发现。
AI.method: 构建 MOSAIC（Multi-agent Open-ended Scientific Analysis and Investigation through Collaboration）协作式 AI 智能体集群（Claude Opus 5.5），由前沿模型 GPT-6 Astra 提出理论框架而非预设模型；多个智能体以多样策略自主探索、快速交流并跨个体整合发现；结合 AI 辅助理论分析、简化模型与单粒子波函数计算。
AI.result: 发现尽管理想量子几何通常被认为有利于分数量子态，偏离该极限反而可显著增强鲁棒性，多体能隙比理想情形高一个数量级以上；无中心协调的智能体可自主探索并整合结果，优于同等工具的孤立智能体；AI 理论分析给出单带近似内无界的解析能隙增强因子，并识别实空间量子度量而非动量空间量子度量为控制多体能隙的关键量，阐明平带波函数如何塑造双电子相互作用，并给出无需多体精确对角化、可由单粒子波函数计算以指导能隙优化的指标。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明协作式 AI 智能体能够整合自主探索、意外物理现象发现与理论理解，为 AI 驱动的基础物理研究提供新范式。

title: Planckian dissipation per unit critical entropy as a coupling-free probe of the strange-metal bath
summary: Strange metals pair a resistivity linear in temperature with a specific heat $C/T$ rising logarithmically on cooling. We find that, if electrons scatter off a local critical bath, the coupling cancels in the ratio $Q$ of their coefficients, leaving two measurable numbers: how slowly the bath relaxes, seen in photoemission or optics, and the share of critical entropy that relaxes current. Baths form classes: $Q\le4.91$ for a conformal bath, as SYK models confirm; 9--15 for the Yukawa--SYK field; and far less for Kondo lattices. LSCO, at $Q\approx9$, exceeds the conformal bound, pointing to the Yukawa--SYK field.

AI.tldr: 作者提出用电阻率线性项与比热对数项的系数比 Q 来判别奇异金属中电子所耦合的局域临界浴类型，并发现 LSCO 的 Q≈9 超出共形浴上限，指向 Yukawa–SYK 场。
AI.motivation: 奇异金属同时表现出电阻率随温度线性变化和 C/T 随降温对数上升，但其背后临界涨落/临界浴的性质尚不明确，需要一个可测量且对电子-浴耦合不敏感的判据。
AI.method: 假设电子散射于局域临界浴，构造线性电阻率系数与对数比热系数的比值 Q；该比值中电子-浴耦合相消，只留下浴的弛豫快慢（可由光电子能谱或光学响应观测）以及临界熵中参与电流弛豫的份额。随后将 Q 与共形浴、Yukawa–SYK 场和 Kondo 晶格等浴类别的理论值比较。
AI.result: 共形浴给出 Q≤4.91，并得到 SYK 模型支持；Yukawa–SYK 场给出 Q≈9–15；Kondo 晶格则远小于这些值。LSCO 的 Q≈9，超过共形浴上限。
AI.conclusion: LSCO 的 Q≈9 表明其奇异金属行为更符合 Yukawa–SYK 场而非共形浴，Q 可作为区分局域临界浴类型的实验判据。

title: AlgebrasTQD: Computing Algebras and Interfaces in Twisted Quantum Doubles
summary: We present AlgebrasTQD, an open-source code written in GAP (Groups, Algorithms, and Programming), for computing condensable algebras and the corresponding topological boundaries and interfaces of twisted quantum doubles $D^\omega(G)$. These algebras can be used to classify 1+1d gapped and gapless phases whose symmetry is related by gauging to a finite group $G$ with anomaly $\omega\in H^3(G,U(1))$, to study 2+1d anyon proliferation and to construct logical gates in non-Abelian topological quantum codes. The functions in AlgebrasTQD compute all condensable algebras $A(H,F,\gamma,\epsilon)$ with their algebra structure and anyons, sort them into isomorphism classes and identify the twin algebras that are inequivalent but share the same anyon decomposition. AlgebrasTQD also determines all the subalgebra relations, the corresponding Hasse diagram and the types of 1+1d phases for any chosen, possibly non-invertible, group-theoretical symmetry. For non-maximal algebras, the code computes the reduced topological order with its $3$-cocycle and the map of anyons across the topological interface. Finally, AlgebrasTQD includes functions that construct certain non-Clifford logical gates via non-Abelian surface codes. We summarize the formulas that are implemented in the AlgebrasTQD code, and we illustrate its use with Abelian and non-Abelian groups including $\mathbb{Z}_2^3$ with $\omega_\text{III}$, $D_8$, $A_4$ with and without anomaly, twin algebras and twin phases, and the Clifford-hierarchy gates in quantum doubles of dihedral groups. All arithmetic is exact and AlgebrasTQD can be used with any finite group $G$ and 3-cocycle $\omega$, limited only by the time and size of the calculation. The code is available at https://github.com/AlisonWarman/AlgebrasTQD

AI.tldr: AlgebrasTQD 是一个基于 GAP 的开源代码，用于计算扭曲量子双模型 D^ω(G) 的可凝聚代数及其拓扑边界/界面，并支持相关相分类、任意子凝聚与拓扑量子门构造。
AI.motivation: 为研究与有限群 G 及其反常 ω∈H^3(G,U(1)) 相关的 1+1 维有能隙/无能隙相、2+1 维任意子增殖，以及非阿贝尔拓扑量子码中的逻辑门，需要一个可精确计算可凝聚代数及其拓扑数据的工具。
AI.method: 该代码计算所有可凝聚代数 A(H,F,γ,ε) 及其代数结构和任意子，按同构类排序并识别共享相同任意子分解但不等价的 twin algebras；确定子代数关系、Hasse 图及任意选定（可能非可逆）群论对称对应的 1+1 维相类型；对非极大代数计算约化拓扑序、其 3-cocycle 及跨拓扑界面的任意子映射；还通过非阿贝尔表面码构造特定非 Clifford 逻辑门。
AI.result: 论文总结了 AlgebrasTQD 中实现的公式，并用 Z_2^3 与 ω_III、D_8、带/不带反常的 A_4、twin algebras 与 twin phases，以及二面体群量子双中的 Clifford 层级门等例子展示其用法；所有算术为精确算术，适用于任意有限群 G 和 3-cocycle ω，仅受计算时间与规模限制。
AI.conclusion: AlgebrasTQD 为扭曲量子双模型中的可凝聚代数、拓扑边界/界面、相分类和拓扑量子码逻辑门提供了一个开源、精确且可扩展的计算框架。

title: Mesons, Confinement, and Complexity: A Krylov Space Perspective on the Long-Range Ising Chain
summary: We investigate the interplay between confinement and Krylov complexity in the long-range transverse-field Ising chain, where power-law interactions $\sim 1/r^{\alpha}$ generate an effective confining potential between domain walls without an explicit symmetry-breaking field. Using the time-averaged Krylov state complexity after a quench as a diagnostic, we find that the complexity is strongly suppressed and only weakly system size-dependent at small $\alpha$ and small transverse field $h_x$, where confinement is strongest, and crosses over to rapid growth at larger $\alpha$, where it increases with system size. Within the confined regime, the oscillation frequencies of the complexity agree with the meson masses of an effective two-kink model, with the dominant frequency growing linearly with the lightest meson mass and the time-averaged complexity decreasing approximately as its inverse square. We further study operator Krylov complexity at finite temperature using the Wightman inner product. At low temperature, it exhibits bounded oscillations that directly encode the meson spectrum, whereas this structure is progressively washed out as the temperature increases. These results identify Krylov complexity as a spectroscopic probe of interaction-induced confinement and reproduce, in a microscopic lattice model, the hallmarks of Krylov complexity identified in confining field theories.

AI.tldr: 该文研究长程横场Ising链中由幂律相互作用诱导的禁闭与Krylov复杂度之间的关系，并表明Krylov复杂度可作为禁闭谱的探针。
AI.motivation: 在无显式对称破缺场时，幂律相互作用可在畴壁间产生有效禁闭势；作者希望用Krylov复杂度诊断这种相互作用诱导的禁闭及其介子谱。
AI.method: 对长程横场Ising链进行淬火，计算时间平均的Krylov态复杂度；在禁闭区用有效双kink模型提取介子质量并与复杂度振荡频率比较；进一步用Wightman内积研究有限温度下的算符Krylov复杂度。
AI.result: 在小α和小横场h_x、禁闭最强时，复杂度被强烈抑制且对系统尺寸依赖很弱；在较大α时转为快速增长并随尺寸增大。禁闭区内复杂度振荡频率与有效双kink模型的介子质量一致，主频随最轻介子质量线性增长，时间平均复杂度约按最轻介子质量的平方反比下降。低温算符Krylov复杂度呈现有界振荡并直接编码介子谱，升温后该结构逐渐被抹平。
AI.conclusion: Krylov复杂度可作为相互作用诱导禁闭的光谱学探针，并在微观格点模型中重现了禁闭场论中Krylov复杂度的典型特征。

title: A cascade of orbital-field-driven phases with a Lifshitz-type transition to unidirectional spiral order
summary: Frustration in magnetic systems gives rise to unconventional orders and exotic spin liquids. Here, we explore a new type of frustration arising from an intrinsic bond-dependent orbital-field that couples orbital degrees of freedom to spin correlations. Introducing this orbital-field interaction into the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice, we show that local spin-orbital constraints generate a subextensive degeneracy, lifted by order-by-disorder to select distinct collinear magnets in a cascade of phases as the orbital field increases from a para-orbital liquid. At larger fields, the selected phase gives way to an incommensurate unidirectional spiral that spontaneously breaks chiral symmetry. This transition is driven by the coupling of a Goldstone mode to gapped dynamical spin-orbital fluctuations. The spin stiffness becomes negative along a particular direction, while the spiral wavevector grows as the square root of the distance from the transition, signaling a Lifshitz-type transition. We present a microscopic route to realizing this orbital field and discuss candidate materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出由键依赖的轨道场引起的一种新型磁阻挫：在蜂窝晶格反铁磁Heisenberg模型中引入轨道-自旋耦合，可产生从para-orbital liquid到级联共线磁序、再到非共线螺旋序的丰富相图。
AI.motivation: 磁阻挫通常导致非常规序和奇异自旋液体；作者旨在探索由内禀键依赖轨道场将轨道自由度与自旋关联耦合所产生的新阻挫机制。
AI.method: 在蜂窝晶格反铁磁Heisenberg模型中加入轨道场相互作用，分析局域自旋-轨道约束导致的亚广延简并，并利用order-by-disorder机制研究简并解除与相选择；进一步通过Goldstone模与有隙动力学自旋-轨道涨落的耦合分析向非公度螺旋相的转变，并考察自旋刚度和螺旋波矢的临界行为。
AI.result: 局域自旋-轨道约束产生亚广延简并，order-by-disorder在其上选择出不同的共线磁体，随着轨道场从para-orbital liquid增大而形成级联相；在较大轨道场下，体系进入自发破缺手征对称性的非公度单向螺旋相。该转变由Goldstone模与有隙动力学自旋-轨道涨落的耦合驱动，自旋刚度沿特定方向变为负值，螺旋波矢随距转变点距离的平方根增长，表现为Lifshitz型转变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了轨道场诱导自旋-轨道阻挫的微观机制，给出了可实验实现的微观路径并讨论了候选材料，为在蜂窝晶格磁体中寻找级联磁序、手征螺旋和Lifshitz型转变提供了新方向。

title: Towards Quantum Computation of Bulk FeO
summary: Quantum computation offers a promising path towards efficient calculations of the electronic structure of correlated materials. The properties of iron-based materials, which are key for advancing geological and astrophysical understanding, are notoriously difficult to calculate with classical computers. However, despite the many recent advances in quantum computing on near intermediate scale quantum hardware, a full treatment of the electronic structure of high-$Z$ atoms or molecules remains challenging. Here, we investigate the ground-state properties of molecular FeO and Fe$_2$O$_2$ model Hamiltonians using classical exact diagonalization, Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD). The experimental quintet ground state of FeO is recovered classically and with quantum algorithms, while a nonet ground state is recovered for Fe$_2$O$_2$. Although raw VQE does not achieve chemical accuracy for the ground state of FeO or Fe$_2$O$_2$, SQD with two connectivity shells recovers the exact ground energy for both molecules utilizing remarkably few quantum computational resources. Overall, our results indicate that $ab \; initio$-informed low-energy models of correlated materials, combined with SQD, offer a new alternative for scaling up calculations of ground-state properties of strongly correlated solids on existing quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 该工作用经典精确对角化、VQE和SQD求解FeO与Fe2O2模型哈密顿量的基态，发现SQD仅需少量量子资源即可恢复精确基态能量。
AI.motivation: 铁基等强关联材料的电子结构对地质与天体物理理解很重要，但经典计算困难；高Z原子/分子的完整量子计算在近中期硬件上仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建FeO和Fe2O2模型哈密顿量，采用经典精确对角化、变分量子本征求解器（VQE）和基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）计算基态性质，并评估不同连通壳层下的SQD表现。
AI.result: FeO的五重态基态和Fe2O2的九重态基态均被恢复；原始VQE未达到FeO或Fe2O2基态的化学精度，而采用两个连通壳层的SQD以极少量子资源获得了两种分子的精确基态能量。
AI.conclusion: 结合从头算启发的低能关联材料模型与SQD，为在现有量子硬件上扩展强关联固体基态性质计算提供了新途径。

title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
summary: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for $N = 4$ and $6$ semions. Scaling up to $N = 16$ semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For $N = 12$ and $16$ semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.

AI.tldr: AnyFormer 是一个用于环面上连续任意子的神经变分蒙特卡洛框架，可显式处理分数统计相互作用与全局绕转约束，并在无外场/相互作用势下研究半子（semion）由统计诱导的关联与手性运动。
AI.motivation: 有限密度下移动任意子的集体行为受分数交换统计影响，但连续空间、环面拓扑边界条件、统计相互作用和绕转约束使微观变分研究困难。作者希望隔离纯粹由统计产生的多体关联，并扩展到连续对角化难以处理的粒子数。
AI.method: 构建平滑轨道框架以严格满足矩阵值环面边界条件，并加入解析两体因子以保证碰撞正则行为；轨道几何与多体振幅通过变分蒙特卡洛并行优化。将该框架应用于无外场和无相互作用势的半子体系，与精确两半子能量及有限截断精确对角化比较。
AI.result: 框架与精确两半子能量吻合，并在 N=4、6 半子时给出低于有限截断精确对角化的变分能量。扩展至 N=16 后，发现显著关联孔、长波密度涨落受抑，以及成对环流在平均粒子间距尺度发生反转；N=12、16 时环流出现阻尼空间振荡。
AI.conclusion: AnyFormer 为研究体相任意子物质的关联、手性运动和集体相提供了可扩展的神经变分微观框架，并展示了纯统计相互作用在有限密度连续任意子体系中的关键效应。

title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
summary:
Solid oxygen is an $S=1$ molecular magnet with strong
  coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom.
  Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments
  coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure.
  We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital
  Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling.
  The resulting model contains competing easy-plane
  single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies.
  We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations
  and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness
  for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern.
  We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable
  among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied.
  Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies
  enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion
  and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.

AI.tldr: 该文从含自旋轨道耦合的双轨道Peierls-Hubbard模型推导有效自旋哈密顿量，并用量子蒙特卡罗研究固体氧中四聚体畸变的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 固体氧是强自旋-晶格耦合的S=1分子磁体，高压下磁矩与四聚体畸变共存；需要揭示其微观自旋模型及各向异性竞争如何选择晶格畸变模式。
AI.method: 从双轨道Peierls-Hubbard模型出发并纳入自旋轨道耦合，推导有效自旋哈密顿量；该模型包含易平面单离子各向异性与易轴交换各向异性的竞争。在方晶格上用量子蒙特卡罗模拟，计算多种畸变模式（包括四聚体模式）下磁对晶格刚度的贡献。
AI.result: 在所研究参数范围内，四聚体畸变模式在考虑的模式中最有利；易平面单离子各向异性与易轴交换各向异性的竞争增强晶格畸变倾向，并加强四聚体化相对于其他模式的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性竞争是稳定固体氧四聚体畸变的关键机制，为高压下磁矩与四聚体畸变共存提供了微观支持。

title: Magnon Super-Bloch Oscillations and Switchable Transport in Driven Magnonic Crystals
summary: Super-Bloch oscillations (SBOs) offer a powerful route to control wave packet propagation in driven lattices, yet their realization in magnonic systems has remained elusive. Here, we predict SBOs of magnon wave packets in periodic magnonic crystals driven by static and ac gradients of magnetic anisotropy field. A static gradient alone induces magnon Bloch oscillation (BO) with a constant carrier frequency. Remarkably, adding a near-resonant MHz-scale ac driving gives rise to a slow large-amplitude envelope oscillation, the hallmark of SBO. At exact resonance, the ac driving enables phase-controlled directional transport with a carrier-frequency shift up to GHz scale. Consequently, the same structure can be switched among three distinct regimes: conventional BO, SBO, and directed transport. Analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, superperiod, drift velocity, and frequency evolution are validated by micromagnetic simulations. Extending to antiferromagnet magnonic crystals, we further demonstrate that these effects drive opposite motions of two oppositely polarized magnon modes in THz range. Our work establishes magnon SBOs as a versatile platform, opening a new avenue for reconfigurable magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 该文预测并验证了周期性磁振子晶体中由静态与交流磁各向异性场梯度驱动的磁振子波包超布洛赫振荡（SBO），并证明可通过共振条件在布洛赫振荡、SBO和定向输运三种 regime 间切换。
AI.motivation: SBO 是驱动晶格中控制波包传播的有力途径，但其在磁振子体系中的实现仍属空白；作者旨在将 SBO 引入磁振子学以实现可重构磁振子器件。
AI.method: 在周期性磁振子晶体中施加静态和交流磁各向异性场梯度驱动磁振子波包；推导振荡幅度、超周期、漂移速度和频率演化的解析表达式，并用微磁模拟验证；进一步推广到反铁磁磁振子晶体。
AI.result: 静态梯度单独产生恒定载频的磁振子布洛赫振荡；加入近共振 MHz 级交流驱动后出现慢速大振幅包络振荡，即 SBO；精确共振时实现相位控制的定向输运，载频移动可达 GHz 量级；同一结构可在传统 BO、SBO 和定向输运间切换；在反铁磁磁振子晶体中，THz 范围内两种相反偏振磁振子模式产生相反运动。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了磁振子 SBO 作为 versatile 平台，为可重构磁振子器件开辟新途径。

title: Stripe antiferromagnetic order and spin dynamics in the Shastry-Sutherland Ising compound Er2Be2GeO7
summary: In rare-earth compounds, the interplay between geometric frustration and unusual single-ion anisotropy caused by the crystal electric field often leads to exotic magnetic phases. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the rare-earth Shastry-Sutherland compound Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ using bulk measurements and neutron scattering down to sub-Kelvin temperatures. A $k=(0,0,0)$ stripe-like antiferromagnetic order with locally tilted Er$^{3+}$ moments is revealed by time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction, accompanied with a $\lambda$-shape specific-heat anomaly at $T_N=0.84$ K. The temperature dependence of the magnetic peak intensity corresponding to the ordered moment of Er$^{3+}$ approximates to the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Thermal- and cold-neutron inelastic scattering experiments demonstrate that the strong Ising anisotropy originates from the local crystal electric field, and reveal gapped magnetic excitations with weak dispersion in the ordered state. Mean-field random-phase approximation with inequivalent nearest-neighbor couplings accounts well for the collective excitations, while classical Monte Carlo simulations yield the fractional $1/4$ and $1/2$ magnetization plateaus. Our work provides a comprehensive description of the spin correlations in Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ with a particular focus on the classical origin of its fractional magnetization plateaus.

AI.tldr: 该文通过体测量与中子散射研究稀土Shastry-Sutherland化合物Er2Be2GeO7的亚开尔文磁性，揭示其k=(0,0,0)条纹状反铁磁序、强Ising各向异性及分数磁化平台。
AI.motivation: 稀土化合物中几何阻挫与晶体电场诱导的单离子各向异性相互作用，可产生奇异磁相；作者旨在厘清Er2Be2GeO7中的自旋关联及分数磁化平台的物理起源。
AI.method: 在亚开尔文温度下开展比热、磁化等体测量，并结合飞行时间中子粉末衍射、热中子与冷中子非弹性散射；理论上采用平均场随机相近似（RPA）和经典Monte Carlo模拟。
AI.result: 发现TN=0.84 K的k=(0,0,0)条纹状反铁磁序，Er3+磁矩局域倾斜，并伴随λ形比热异常；有序矩对应的磁峰强度温度依赖接近二维Ising普适类。非弹性散射表明强Ising各向异性源于局域晶体电场，有序态中存在弱色散的有能隙磁激发；非等价最近邻耦合的RPA可解释集体激发，经典Monte Carlo给出1/4和1/2分数磁化平台。
AI.conclusion: 工作全面描述了Er2Be2GeO7中的自旋关联，并强调其分数磁化平台可由经典机制解释。

title: New Developments in Diagrammatic Monte Carlo for Interacting Lattice Fermions: Efficient Algorithms and Applications
summary:
This thesis develops diagrammatic methods for thermodynamic and subsystem quantities of interacting lattice fermions, providing reference calculations for quantum simulators and many-body approximations. I formulate an inverse-flavour expansion about a self-consistent Hartree saddle, enumerate non-Gaussian diagrams, and use a discrete Lehmann representation to integrate selected internal vertices analytically. Density results cover 31 state points of the six-flavour Hubbard model on a $70\times70$ lattice at $T/t=0.15$.
  I generalize combinatorial summation to flavour-dependent propagators and expansion shifts. CoS++ combines partial contractions to obtain connected sums for interaction subsets. A determinant-polynomial sieve evaluates the same sums through local coefficient filters; at ninth order it is 24--25 times faster than the specified CoS baselines in three-flavour dense-random-matrix benchmarks. Thermodynamic applications include a 2048-site honeycomb lattice and a three-flavour square lattice with 1024 sites.
  For the second Renyi entropy, I derive a fermionic replica path integral and a stable evaluation of its two-time Green functions. The connected-determinant calculation reaches tenth order on a $3\times3$ cluster and ninth order on larger lattices. On $50\times50$ sites at $(U/t,\mu/t,\beta t)=(3,1,8)$, the ninth-order continuation at shift $\alpha=1.3$ gives $S_2/N_s=0.06695$ with propagated Monte Carlo uncertainty $3.0\times10^{-5}$. Comparing two expansion shifts at their respective retained orders gives an endpoint difference of $2.6\times10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文发展了用于相互作用格点费米子热力学量与子系统量的图解方法，给出可用于量子模拟器基准和多体近似检验的参考计算。
AI.motivation: 量子模拟器和多体近似需要高精度、可扩展的参考结果；现有图解求和与纠缠熵计算在多味道、有限温度和大格点下仍缺乏系统方法。
AI.method: 围绕自洽Hartree鞍点构造逆味道展开，枚举非高斯图，并用离散Lehmann表示解析积分部分内部顶点；将组合求和推广到味道依赖传播子和展开平移，提出CoS++的部分收缩连通求和以及基于局部系数滤波的行列式多项式筛；对第二Renyi熵推导费米子复制路径积分及稳定的双时Green函数计算。
AI.result: 密度计算覆盖70×70格点六味道Hubbard模型在T/t=0.15下的31个状态点；三味道稠密随机矩阵基准中，九阶行列式多项式筛比指定CoS基线快24–25倍；热力学应用包括2048格点蜂窝晶格和1024格点三味道方晶格；第二Renyi熵在3×3簇达到十阶、较大格点达到九阶，在50×50、 (U/t,μ/t,βt)=(3,1,8) 时九阶延拓给出 S2/Ns=0.06695，Monte Carlo不确定度3.0×10^-5，两个展开平移端点差2.6×10^-4。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了可推广的费米子图解计算框架，兼顾热力学量和高阶Renyi熵，并为量子模拟器及多体近似提供定量参考与可扩展算法。

title: Topological Criticality with Charge-\(3e\) Fluctuations in the \(\mathrm{SU}(3)\) Triangular-Lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard Model
summary: A transition between an integer quantum Hall insulator and a chiral spin liquid can become critical without closing the single-electron gap, raising the question of which composite excitations govern the change in topological order. We investigate this question in the \(\mathrm{SU}(3)\) triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model at one particle per site and magnetic flux \(\pi/3\) per triangle. Using infinite density matrix renormalization group calculations, we identify a weak-coupling integer quantum Hall phase and an interaction-driven \(\mathrm{SU}(3)_1\) chiral spin liquid. Near the transition, both the neutral and charge-\(3e\) correlation lengths increase substantially, whereas the single-electron correlation length remains short, providing evidence for a Chern--Simons--Higgs critical theory, where a gauge-invariant monopole carries the quantum numbers of a fermionic \(\mathrm{SU}(3)\)-singlet trion. We discuss the implications for doping the system and recent experiments on doping \(\nu=-2/3\) fractional quantum anomalous Hall in tMoTe\(_2\).

AI.tldr: 该文用无限密度矩阵重整化群研究SU(3)三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中整数量子霍尔绝缘体与手性自旋液体之间的临界转变，发现转变可不关闭单电子能隙，并由中性及电荷3e复合激发主导。
AI.motivation: 整数量子霍尔绝缘体与手性自旋液体之间的拓扑序转变若不在单电子能隙闭合时发生，其临界理论及主导复合激发尚不明确。
AI.method: 在每格点一个粒子、每三角磁通π/3条件下，对SU(3)三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型进行无限密度矩阵重整化群计算。
AI.result: 识别出弱耦合整数量子霍尔相和相互作用驱动的SU(3)_1手性自旋液体；近临界处中性和电荷3e关联长度显著增大，而单电子关联长度保持较短，支持Chern-Simons-Higgs临界理论，其中规范不变单极子携带费米型SU(3)单态三聚体的量子数。
AI.conclusion: 该转变由复合激发而非单电子能隙闭合描述，并对掺杂该体系及解释tMoTe2中ν=-2/3分数量子反常霍尔态掺杂实验具有启示。

title: Same-spin correlation screens the exchange peak of the electron gas near 2kF
summary: Exchange alone gives the electron gas a local field factor with a sharp peak just below 2kF. Quantum Monte Carlo finds none. Both spin channels are computed here from their lowest diagrams with a dynamically screened interaction and no fitting. Parallel spin correlation is the negative image of exchange and removes about half the peak; the calculated spin-resolved factors account for the QMC data at rs = 1 and 2, and at q = 0 for the compressibility and spin susceptibility obtained from the ground-state energy. The two classes of diagrams are the two terms of the kernel of Hedin's vertex equation, of which the second is routinely dropped.

AI.tldr: 本文无需拟合，用动态屏蔽相互作用的最低阶图计算电子气的自旋分辨局域场因子，说明交换项在略低于2kF处的尖峰为何在QMC中消失：平行自旋关联作为交换的负像抵消约一半尖峰，且结果与rs=1、2的QMC数据及q=0处由基态能量得到的压缩率和自旋磁化率一致。
AI.motivation: 单独考虑交换时，电子气局域场因子在略低于2kF处出现尖峰，但量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）未观察到该峰；需要厘清交换与平行自旋关联的贡献，并检验Hedin顶点方程中常被丢弃的第二项是否重要。
AI.method: 从两个自旋通道的最低阶图出发，采用动态屏蔽相互作用且不做拟合；所包含的两类图对应Hedin顶点方程核的两个项，其中第二项通常被省略。
AI.result: 平行自旋关联是交换的负像，可消除约一半尖峰；计算得到的自旋分辨局域场因子在rs=1和2时解释QMC数据，并在q=0处与由基态能量获得的压缩率和自旋磁化率相符。
AI.conclusion: Hedin顶点方程核的第二项不能常规丢弃；计入两类图后，交换尖峰被平行自旋关联显著削弱，从而与QMC及宏观响应函数一致。

title: Large superconducting diode effect indicates nonuniform triplet pairing in UTe2
summary: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) is characterized by unequal critical current magnitudes for opposite-polarity current flow, owing to broken spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetries. For a superconducting pair wavefunction to spontaneously break inversion symmetry implies the formation of Cooper pairs with nonzero momentum, yielding a nonuniform superconducting state. For singlet superconductors, the formation of such a (FFLO) state has long been understood to provide an escape from high field Pauli pair-breaking -- how and why such an effect might occur for equal spin pairing is an open question. Here we report the observation of a large SDE in bulk specimens of the three-dimensional heavy-fermion triplet superconductor UTe$_2$, with a peak diode efficiency of 33% at the high magnetic field strength of 33.6 T, representing the highest-field observation of the SDE to date. Crucially, this nonreciprocal transport is strictly confined to a narrow field regime where superconductivity coexists with a field-induced spin-polarized state near a first-order metamagnetic phase boundary. The absence of the SDE away from this slender phase-intersection argues strongly against purely extrinsic vortex pinning asymmetries. Instead, our findings indicate spontaneous inversion symmetry breaking accompanied by finite-momentum Cooper pairing. We model this behavior using a phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theory, demonstrating that the intertwining of magnetic and triplet superconducting orders can stabilize an odd-parity FFLO state.

AI.tldr: 在三维重费米子三重态超导体 UTe$_2$ 中观察到高场超导二极管效应，峰值效率 33%、磁场 33.6 T，并归因于磁性序与三重态超导交织稳定的奇宇称 FFLO 态。
AI.motivation: 超导二极管效应源于空间反演与时间反演对称性破缺；对自旋单态，FFLO 态可解释高场下规避 Pauli 配对破坏，但等自旋配对体系中该效应如何产生尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对 UTe$_2$ 块体样品进行高磁场非互易输运测量，并结合唯象 Ginzburg-Landau 理论建模分析磁性序与三重态超导序的耦合。
AI.result: 观察到峰值二极管效率 33% 的大 SDE，对应 33.6 T 的高磁场；该非互易输运严格局限于超导与场致自旋极化态共存、靠近一阶变磁相变的窄场区，远离该相区时 SDE 消失。
AI.conclusion: 结果反对纯外禀涡旋钉扎不对称解释，支持自发反演对称性破缺与有限动量 Cooper 配对，表明磁性序与三重态超导交织可稳定奇宇称 FFLO 态。

title: Vortex anisotropy in chiral and nematic superconductors with strain
summary: Unconventional superconductors with a two-component order parameter support the existence of a rotational symmetry breaking nematic phase and a time-reversal symmetry breaking chiral phase. A recent experiment on 4Hb-TaS$_2$ surprisingly shows both twofold anisotropy in $H_{c2}$, which suggests nematic superconductivity, as well as isotropic vortices at low temperatures, which suggest chiral superconductivity. To resolve this apparent conundrum we write down the appropriate Ginzburg-Landau equations and develop a numerically efficient algorithm for finding vortex solutions, allowing us to study their shape and anisotropy over a broad parameter range. We also demonstrate analytically that, to leading order, the vortex anisotropy is independent of strain in the nematic case, but is linearly dependent on it in the chiral phase, providing a possible way to distinguish the two phases. Using all these results we show that, in the presence of strain, in a large parameter regime the system behaves nematically near the transition, leading to an anisotropy of $H_{c2}$, but is dominantly chiral away from the transition, leading to parametrically smaller vortex anisotropy, in line with the experiment.

AI.tldr: 为解释4Hb-TaS2中Hc2二重各向异性（似向列超导）与低温各向同性涡旋（似手征超导）并存的矛盾，作者建立双分量Ginzburg-Landau理论并数值求解涡旋，表明在应变下近转变处向列序主导、远离转变处手征序主导。
AI.motivation: 双分量非常规超导体可支持旋转对称性破缺的向列相和时间反演对称性破缺的手征相；4Hb-TaS2实验同时观察到向列型Hc2各向异性和手征型各向同性涡旋，形成 apparent conundrum，需要统一理论解释。
AI.method: 写出适用于双分量序参量的Ginzburg-Landau方程，发展高效数值算法求解涡旋并在大参数范围内研究其形状与各向异性；同时解析证明到主导阶，向列相中涡旋各向异性与应变无关，而手征相中线性依赖应变。
AI.result: 结果表明涡旋各向异性可区分向列相与手征相；存在应变时，在大参数区域内系统于转变附近表现为向列性，导致Hc2各向异性，而远离转变时以手征性为主，使涡旋各向异性在参数上更小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为4Hb-TaS2中向列型Hc2各向异性与低温近各向同性涡旋的共存提供自洽解释，并给出利用应变依赖的涡旋各向异性辨别向列与手征超导相的判据。

title: Proximity-Induced Giant Majorana Spin Response in a UTe$_2$-Metal Film Heterostructure
summary: We establish an experimentally accessible route to identifying Majorana surface states through their intrinsic Ising spin response, using UTe$_2$ as a concrete platform. The key is to extend the Majorana correlations into an adjacent metallic film via the superconducting proximity effect, thereby making the otherwise surface-localized response accessible to NMR measurements. Remarkably, disorder further sharpens the Majorana signature: impurity scattering suppresses the conventional $p$-wave proximity correlations while preserving the Majorana contribution, yielding a giant Ising-anisotropic enhancement of the NMR relaxation rate. This approach also offers a powerful means to distinguish among candidate pairing symmetries.

AI.tldr: 以UTe$_2$为平台，通过超导邻近效应将Majorana表面关联扩展到相邻金属薄膜，用NMR探测其本征Ising自旋响应，并利用无序增强信号、区分候选配对对称性。
AI.motivation: Majorana表面态通常局域于表面而难以实验探测；需要一种实验可及的识别方案，同时鉴别UTe$_2$的候选配对对称性。
AI.method: 将UTe$_2$与相邻金属薄膜耦合，借助超导邻近效应把Majorana关联引入薄膜；分析杂质散射对常规$p$波邻近关联与Majorana贡献的不同影响，并用NMR弛豫率探测Ising各向异性响应。
AI.result: 无序反而锐化Majorana特征：杂质散射压制常规$p$波邻近关联但保留Majorana贡献，导致NMR弛豫率出现巨大的Ising各向异性增强。
AI.conclusion: 该方案提供了实验可及的Majorana表面态识别途径，并可作为区分UTe$_2$候选配对对称性的有力手段。

title: Determination of the Magnetic Penetration Depth from Finite-Element Susceptibility Calculations of Spheroidal and Cylindrical Superconductors
summary: The magnetic penetration depth, $\lambda$, is a fundamental parameter of the superconducting state and is commonly determined from precision measurements of the magnetic susceptibility, $\chi$, in the Meissner state. However, extracting $\lambda$ from such measurements requires an accurate treatment of geometry-dependent demagnetization effects, for which analytic results are only available in a limited number of cases. Here we present a finite-element analysis of the magnetic response of three dimensional superconducting spheroids and cylinders with finite penetration depth. By calculating the magnetic moment and susceptibility, $\chi(\lambda)$, over a wide range of aspect ratios, we quantify the shape-dependent Meissner response and extract effective demagnetization factors in the $\lambda \rightarrow 0$ limit. For small but finite $\lambda$, we further determine effective sample dimensions from the initial variation of $\chi(\lambda)$ and propose an improved analytical expression for these. Our results provide a high-precision procedure for determining $\lambda$ from volume-exclusion based susceptibility measurements and should be directly applicable to the characterization of novel superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 本文用有限元方法系统分析三维超导椭球体和圆柱体在有限磁穿透深度下的迈斯纳磁响应，给出从磁化率测量中高精度提取穿透深度λ的方法。
AI.motivation: 从迈斯纳态磁化率χ提取磁穿透深度λ时，必须准确处理几何相关的退磁效应，但现有解析结果仅适用于少数形状，限制了体积排斥型磁化率测量的定量应用。
AI.method: 对具有有限穿透深度的三维超导椭球体和圆柱体进行有限元分析，在广泛长宽比范围内计算磁矩与磁化率χ(λ)，在λ→0极限提取有效退磁因子，并利用χ(λ)的初始变化确定小但有限λ下的有效样品尺寸。
AI.result: 量化了形状依赖的迈斯纳响应，给出了λ→0极限下的有效退磁因子；针对小但有限λ，从χ(λ)初段变化确定有效样品尺寸，并提出改进的解析表达式。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了基于体积排斥磁化率测量确定λ的高精度流程，可直接用于新型超导材料的表征。

title: Nano-Nb Superconducting 3D Josephson Junctions Arrays in Cu-Normal Matrix: Superconducting Phase Coherence and Quantum Fluctuations Properties
summary: To address the complex interplay of microstructural evolution, phase separation, superconductivity coherence and quantum fluctuations, we prepared Cuxwt%Nb series of granular samples by rapidly cooling, where the niobium concentration varied (x = 3, 5, 15, 20).
